s.id === selectedSession.id);\n        if (updated) {\n          setSelectedSession(updated);\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载会话列表失败:', error);\n      toast.error('加载会话列表失败');\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const loadMessages = async (sessionId: string) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      setLoadingMessages(true);\n      const data = await brainstormService.getMessages(sessionId);\n      setMessages(data);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载消息失败:', error);\n      toast.error('加载消息失败');\n    } finally {\n      setLoadingMessages(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const startPolling = (sessionId: string) =&gt; {\n    // 如果会话是活跃状态，每3秒轮询一次\n    const interval = setInterval(async () =&gt; {\n      try {\n        const status = await brainstormService.getSessionStatus(sessionId);\n        if (status.isActive || status.status === 'active') {\n          await loadMessages(sessionId);\n          // 同时更新会话状态\n          const updated = await brainstormService.getSession(sessionId);\n          setSelectedSession(updated);\n        } else {\n          // 讨论已结束，停止轮询\n          stopPolling();\n          await loadMessages(sessionId);\n          const updated = await brainstormService.getSession(sessionId);\n          setSelectedSession(updated);\n        }\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('轮询失败:', error);\n      }\n    }, 3000);\n\n    setPollingInterval(interval);\n  };\n\n  const stopPolling = () =&gt;         "contents": "import aiRoleService from '../services/aiRoleService';\n\nconst DEFAULT_CONTEXT_STRATEGY: DirectAgentConfig['contextStrategy'] = {\n  type: 'window',\n  maxMessages: 20,\n  maxTokens: 4000,\n  includeSystemPrompt: true\n};\n\nexport const PRESET_ROLES: Record&lt;string, Partial&lt;AIRoleConfig&gt;&gt; = {\n  'five-view-analysis': {\n    name: '技术转译（五看）助手',\n    description: '用于进行\"五看\"（看行业、看市场、看客户、看竞争、看自己）分析。',\n    provider: 'direct-agent',\n    agentConfig: {\n      llm: {\n        provider: 'openai',\n        model: 'gpt-4o',\n        temperature: 0.7,\n        maxTokens: 2000,\n        apiKey: 'sk-placeholder-please-update',\n      },\n      prompt: {\n        systemPrompt: &#96;你是一位战略分析专家，擅长使用\"五看\"方法论进行深度分析。\n\n你的任务是根据输入的信息，进行以下五个维度的分析：\n1. **看行业 (Industry)**: 行业趋势、政策导向、技术变革。\n2. **看市场 (Market)**: 市场规模、增长潜力、细分领域。\n3. **看客户 (Customer)**: 客户画像、痛点需求、购买行为。\n4. **看竞争 (Competition)**: 竞争格局、主要对手、SWOT分析。\n5. **看自己 (Self)**: 自身优势、短板、核心竞争力。\n\n请输出结构化的分析报告，并给出战略建议。&#96;,\n      },\n      contextStrategy: DEFAULT_CONTEXT_STRATEGY\n    }\n  },\n  'three-fix-analysis': {\n    name: '用户场景挖掘（三定）助手',\n};",

        "contents": "export class StructuredContextManager {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 构建摘要提示词\n   */\n  private buildSummaryPrompt(\n    topic: string,\n    description: string | undefined,\n    messages: BrainstormMessageDTO[],\n    participants: BrainstormParticipantDTO[],\n    config: StructuredContextConfig\n  ): string {\n    const messagesText = this.formatMessagesForSummary(messages, participants);\n\n    let prompt = &#96;请对以下头脑风暴讨论进行结构化摘要：\n\n讨论话题：${topic}\n${description ? &#96;话题描述：${description}\\n&#96; : ''}\n\n参与专家：\n${participants.map((p, i) =&gt; &#96;${i + 1}. ${p.displayName || p.aiRole?.name || '专家'}${p.roleType ? &#96;（${p.roleType}）&#96; : ''}&#96;).join('\\n')}\n\n讨论记录：\n${messagesText}\n\n请提供一份结构化的JSON格式摘要，包含以下内容：\n&#96;;\n\n    prompt += &#96;{\n  \"summary\": \"讨论的核心摘要（200字以内）\",\n  \"keyPoints\": [\n    {\n      \"participantId\": \"参与者ID\",\n      \"participantName\": \"参与者名称\",\n      \"point\": \"关键观点\",\n      \"confidence\": 0.8,\n      \"supportingEvidence\": [\"支撑证据1\", \"支撑证据2\"],\n      \"roundNumber\": 1\n    }\n  ]&#96;;\n\n    if (config.detectDisagreements) {\n      prompt += &#96;,\n  \"disagreements\": [\n    {\n      \"topic\": \"分歧主题\",\n      \"positions\": {\n        \"participantId1\": \"观点1\",\n        \"participantId2\": \"观点2\"\n      }\n    }\n  ],\n  \"consensus\": [\"共识点1\", \"共识点2\"]&#96;;\n    }\n\n    prompt += &#96;\n}\n\n要求：\n1. summary要简洁明了，突出核心讨论内容\n2. keyPoints要提取每个专家的核心观点，按重要性排序\n3. ${config.detectDisagreements ? 'disagreements要识别出明显的分歧点' : ''}\n4. 所有字段必须完整，使用有效的JSON格式&#96;;\n\n    return prompt;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 格式化消息用于摘要\n   */\n  private formatMessagesForSummary(\n    messages: BrainstormMessageDTO[],\n    participants: BrainstormParticipantDTO[]\n  ): string {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "const EmbeddedTechArticlePage: React.FC&lt;EmbeddedTechArticlePageProps&gt; = \n() =&gt; {\n\n  }, []);\n\n  const handleSelectionChange = useCallback((selection: {\n    conversationIds: string[];\n    outputIds: string[];\n  }) =&gt; {\n    setSelectedSources(selection);\n  }, []);\n\n  const handleGenerate = async () =&gt; {\n    if (selectedSources.conversationIds.length === 0 &amp;&amp; selectedSources.outputIds.length === 0) {\n      message.warning('请至少选择一个对话或输出内容');\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (articleTypes.length === 0) {\n      message.warning('请至少选择一种文章类型');\n      return;\n    }\n\n    setIsGenerating(true);\n    try {\n      const result = await aiSearchService.aggregateTechArticle({\n        conversationIds: selectedSources.conversationIds,\n        outputIds: selectedSources.outputIds,\n        articleTypes,\n        tone,\n        targetAudience,\n      });\n\n      setGeneratedArticle(result);\n      setViewMode('optimize');\n      \n      // 创建优化对话，关联项目ID\n      const projectIdNum = parseInt(projectId);\n      const conversation = await aiSearchService.createConversation({\n        title: '技术通稿优化对话',\n        sources: [],\n        pageType: 'tech-article',\n        projectId: !isNaN(projectIdNum) ? projectIdNum : undefined,\n      });\n\n      // 发送初始消息，包含生成的通稿内容\n      if (conversation) {\n        await aiSearchService.sendMessage(conversation.id, {\n          content: &#96;请帮我优化以下技术通稿内容。\\n\\n${JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)}&#96;,\n          sources: [],\n        });\n        const updatedConversation = await aiSearchService.getConversation(conversation.id);\n        setOptimizeConversation(updatedConversation);\n      }\n\n      message.success('技术通稿生成成功');\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.error('生成技术通稿失败:', error);\n      message.error(error.message || '生成技术通稿失败');\n    } finally {\n      setIsGenerating(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleEditVersion = (versionType: string, content: any) =&gt;\n;\n;",

        "contents": "export class AgentOrchestrator {\nasync executeAgent(\n    roleId: string,\n    query: string,\n    conversationId: string = '',\n    context: Record&lt;string, any&gt; = {}\n  ): Promise&lt;AgentExecutionResult&gt; {\n\n      \n      // 根据策略决定是否包含 system prompt\n      if (config.contextStrategy.includeSystemPrompt || contextMessages.length === 0) {\n        messages.push({\n          role: 'system',\n          content: systemPrompt\n        });\n      }\n\n      messages.push(...contextMessages);\n      messages.push({\n        role: 'user',\n        content: query\n      });\n\n      // 6. 准备工具定义（Function Calling）\n      const tools = this.prepareTools(config.tools || []);\n\n      // 7. 获取 LLM Provider\n      const provider = this.getProvider(config.llm);\n\n      // 8. 调用 LLM（可能包含多轮工具调用）\n      checkTimeout();\n      const llmStartTime = Date.now();\n      let response = await this.executeWithTools(provider, messages, config.llm, tools, config.tools || [], checkTimeout, executionId);\n      const llmDuration = Date.now() - llmStartTime;\n      \n      // 记录性能指标\n      await this.recordPerformanceMetrics(executionId, 'llm_call', llmDuration, response.usage);\n      \n      await this.logStep(executionId, 'llm_call', {\n        type: 'llm',\n        input: { messageCount: messages.length, toolCount: tools.length },\n        output: { content: response.content, toolCalls: response.toolCalls?.length || 0 },\n        duration: llmDuration,\n        status: 'success'\n      });\n\n      // 9. 保存消息历史\n      await this.saveMessages(finalConversationId, query, response, roleId);\n\n      // 10. 返回结果\n      const totalDuration = Date.now() - startTime;\n      \n      // 记录总体执行时间\n      await this.recordPerformanceMetrics(executionId, 'execution_time', totalDuration, { \n        roleId, \n        toolCalls: response.toolCalls?.length || 0 \n      });\n      \n      await this.logStep(executionId, 'complete', {\n        type: 'complete',\n        input: { query },\n        output: { content: response.content },\n        duration: totalDuration,\n        status: 'success'\n      });\n\n      return\n  }\n}",

        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./.cursor/plans/头脑风暴群聊功能_56f3b3c9.plan.md",

          "endPosition": {
            "line": 358
          }
        },
        "contents": "#### BrainstormMessageList（消息列表组件）\n\n**位置**: &#96;frontend/src/components/brainstorm/BrainstormMessageList.tsx&#96;**功能**:\n\n- 按轮次分组显示消息\n- 区分不同专家的发言（头像+名称）\n- 支持展开/折叠某一轮的讨论\n\n#### BrainstormSummary（总结组件）\n\n**位置**: &#96;frontend/src/components/brainstorm/BrainstormSummary.tsx&#96;**功能**:\n\n- 显示 AI 生成的讨论总结\n- 支持复制和导出\n- 显示关键观点提取\n\n### 4.3 服务层\n\n**位置**: &#96;frontend/src/services/brainstormService.ts&#96;封装所有后端 API 调用：\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nexport const brainstormService = {\n  createSession(data: CreateSessionDTO): Promise&lt;Session&gt;,\n  listSessions(): Promise&lt;Session[]&gt;,\n  getSession(id: string): Promise&lt;SessionDetail&gt;,\n  startSession(id: string): Promise&lt;void&gt;,\n  stopSession(id: string): Promise&lt;void&gt;,\n  getMessages(id: string): Promise&lt;Message[]&gt;,\n  getSummary(id: string): Promise&lt;Summary&gt;\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n\n\n## 五、关键技术要点\n\n### 5.1 并行执行与上下文构建\n\n每个 Agent 调用时的 Prompt 结构：\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\n系统角色：你是[专家领域]专家\n讨论话题：[话题标题和描述]\n\n历史讨论记录：\n[轮次1]\n- 专家A: xxx\n- 专家B: xxx\n\n[轮次2]\n- 专家A: xxx\n- 专家B: xxx\n\n请从你的专业角度发表观点，可以：\n1. 提出新的见解\n2. 补充其他专家的观点\n3. 指出潜在问题\n4. 提供具体建议\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n\n\n### 5.2 终止条件判断\n\n**轮次限制**: 简单计数判断**共识检测** (可选，V2 实现):\n\n- 使用一个额外的 LLM 调用分析讨论内容\n- 判断是否已经形成共识或话题已充分讨论\n\n### 5.3 总结生成\n\n使用专门的 Summarizer Agent：\n\n- 输入：完整的讨论记录\n- 输出：\n- 核心观点汇总\n- 各方共识\n- 分歧点（如有）\n- 建议结论\n\n### 5.4 性能优化\n\n**并发控制**:\n\n- 使用 &#96;Promise.allSettled()&#96; 避免单个 Agent 失败导致整体失败\n- 设置超时机制（单个 Agent 6分钟，整轮讨论 10分钟）",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "#### BrainstormMessageList（消息列表组件）",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 273

          {
            "text": "**位置**: &#96;frontend/src/components/brainstorm/BrainstormMessageList.tsx&#96;**功能**:",
            "lineNumber": 274
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 275
          },
          {
            "text": "- 按轮次分组显示消息",
            "lineNumber": 276
          },
          {
            "text": "- 区分不同专家的发言（头像+名称）",
            "lineNumber": 277
          },
          {
            "text": "- 支持展开/折叠某一轮的讨论",
            "lineNumber": 278
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 279
          },
          {
            "text": "#### BrainstormSummary（总结组件）",
            "lineNumber": 280
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 281
          },
          {
            "text": "**位置**: &#96;frontend/src/components/brainstorm/BrainstormSummary.tsx&#96;**功能**:",
            "lineNumber": 282
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 283
          },
          {
            "text": "- 显示 AI 生成的讨论总结",
            "lineNumber": 284
          },
          {
            "text": "- 支持复制和导出",
            "lineNumber": 285
          },
          {
            "text": "- 显示关键观点提取",
            "lineNumber": 286
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 287
          },
          {
            "text": "### 4.3 服务层",
            "lineNumber": 288
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 289
          },
          {
            "text": "**位置**: &#96;frontend/src/services/brainstormService.ts&#96;封装所有后端 API 调用：",
            "lineNumber": 290
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 291
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",
            "lineNumber": 292
          },
          {
            "text": "export const brainstormService = {",
            "lineNumber": 293
          },
          {
            "text": "  createSession(data: CreateSessionDTO): Promise&lt;Session&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 294
          },
          {
            "text": "  listSessions(): Promise&lt;Session[]&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 295
          },
          {
            "text": "  getSession(id: string): Promise&lt;SessionDetail&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 296
          },
          {
            "text": "  startSession(id: string): Promise&lt;void&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 297
          },
          {
            "text": "  stopSession(id: string): Promise&lt;void&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 298
          },
          {
            "text": "  getMessages(id: string): Promise&lt;Message[]&gt;,",
            "lineNumber": 299
          },
          {
            "text": "  getSummary(id: string): Promise&lt;Summary&gt;",

          },
          {

          },

            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 303
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 304
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 305
          },
          {
            "text": "## 五、关键技术要点",
            "lineNumber": 306
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 307
          },
          {
            "text": "### 5.1 并行执行与上下文构建",
            "lineNumber": 308
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 309
          },
          {
            "text": "每个 Agent 调用时的 Prompt 结构：",
            "lineNumber": 310
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 311
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript",
            "lineNumber": 312
          },
          {
            "text": "系统角色：你是[专家领域]专家",
            "lineNumber": 313
          },
          {
            "text": "讨论话题：[话题标题和描述]",
            "lineNumber": 314
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 315
          },
          {
            "text": "历史讨论记录：",
            "lineNumber": 316
          },
          {
            "text": "[轮次1]",
            "lineNumber": 317
          },
          {
            "text": "- 专家A: xxx",
            "lineNumber": 318
          },
          {
            "text": "- 专家B: xxx",
            "lineNumber": 319
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 320
          },
          {
            "text": "[轮次2]",
            "lineNumber": 321
          },
          {
            "text": "- 专家A: xxx",
            "lineNumber": 322
          },
          {
            "text": "- 专家B: xxx",
            "lineNumber": 323
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 324
          },
          {
            "text": "请从你的专业角度发表观点，可以：",
            "lineNumber": 325
          },
          {
            "text": "1. 提出新的见解",
            "lineNumber": 326
          },
          {
            "text": "2. 补充其他专家的观点",
            "lineNumber": 327
          },
          {
            "text": "3. 指出潜在问题",
            "lineNumber": 328
          },
          {
            "text": "4. 提供具体建议",
            "lineNumber": 329
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 330
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 331
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 332
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 333
          },
          {
            "text": "### 5.2 终止条件判断",
            "lineNumber": 334
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 335
          },
          {
            "text": "**轮次限制**: 简单计数判断**共识检测** (可选，V2 实现):",
            "lineNumber": 336
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 337
          },
          {
            "text": "- 使用一个额外的 LLM 调用分析讨论内容",
            "lineNumber": 338
          },
          {
            "text": "- 判断是否已经形成共识或话题已充分讨论",
            "lineNumber": 339
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 340
          },
          {
            "text": "### 5.3 总结生成",
            "lineNumber": 341
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 342
          },
          {
            "text": "使用专门的 Summarizer Agent：",
            "lineNumber": 343
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 344
          },
          {
            "text": "- 输入：完整的讨论记录",
            "lineNumber": 345
          },
          {
            "text": "- 输出：",
            "lineNumber": 346
          },
          {
            "text": "- 核心观点汇总",
            "lineNumber": 347
          },
          {
            "text": "- 各方共识",
            "lineNumber": 348
          },
          {
            "text": "- 分歧点（如有）",
            "lineNumber": 349
          },
          {
            "text": "- 建议结论",
            "lineNumber": 350
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 351
          },
          {
            "text": "### 5.4 性能优化",
            "lineNumber": 352
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 353
          },
          {
            "text": "**并发控制**:",
            "lineNumber": 354
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 355
          },
          {
            "text": "- 使用 &#96;Promise.allSettled()&#96; 避免单个 Agent 失败导致整体失败",
            "lineNumber": 356
          },
          {
            "text": "- 设置超时机制（单个 Agent 6分钟，整轮讨论 10分钟）",
            "lineNumber": 357
          }
        ]
      },

        "contents": "export const BrainstormSetupModal: React.FC&lt;BrainstormSetupModalProps&gt; = ({\n  isOpen,\n  onClose,\n  onSubmit,\n  initialData,\n  projectId,\n}) =&gt; {\n  const [title, setTitle] = useState(initialData?.title || '');\n  const [topic, setTopic] = useState(initialData?.topic || '');\n  const [description, setDescription] = useState(initialData?.description || '');\n  const [selectedRoleIds, setSelectedRoleIds] = useState&lt;string[]&gt;(\n    initialData?.participantRoleIds || []\n  );\n  const [maxRounds, setMaxRounds] = useState&lt;number | ''&gt;(\n    initialData?.config?.stopConditions?.maxRounds ?? 5\n  );\n  const [consensusDetection, setConsensusDetection] = useState(\n    initialData?.config?.stopConditions?.consensusDetection ?? false\n  );\n  const [discussionMode, setDiscussionMode] = useState&lt;'parallel' | 'round-robin'&gt;(\n    initialData?.config?.discussionMode ?? 'parallel'\n  );\n  const [moderatorEnabled, setModeratorEnabled] = useState(\n    initialData?.config?.moderatorConfig?.enabled ?? false\n  );\n  const [moderatorRoleId, setModeratorRoleId] = useState(\n    initialData?.config?.moderatorConfig?.moderatorRoleId ??         "contents": "export class BrainstormSessionModel {\n\n\n\n  /**\n   * 创建会话\n   */\n  async create(data: CreateBrainstormSessionDTO): Promise&lt;BrainstormSessionDTO&gt; {\n    const id = data.id || this.generateId();\n    const now = new Date().toISOString();\n    \n    const defaultConfig: BrainstormSessionConfig = {\n      stopConditions: {\n        manualStop: true,\n        maxRounds: 5,\n        consensusDetection: false,\n        consensusConfig: {\n          enabled: false,\n          method: 'hybrid',\n          threshold: 0.7,\n          minAgreementRatio: 0.7,\n          recentRounds: 3,\n        },\n      },\n      discussionMode: 'parallel',\n      summaryConfig: {\n        enabled: true,\n        provider: 'same-as-agents',\n      },\n      reflectionLoop: {\n        enabled: false,\n        maxIterations: 3,\n        qualityThreshold: 0.7,\n        reflectionFrequency: 3,\n      },\n      structuredContext: {\n        enabled: true,\n        summaryFrequency: 3,\n        extractKeyPoints: true,\n        detectDisagreements: true,\n        maxContextTokens: 8000,\n      },\n      debateConfig: {\n        enabled: false,\n        proRoleIds: [],\n        conRoleIds: [],\n        rounds: 3,\n      },\n    };\n\n    const config = { ...defaultConfig, ...data.config };\n    \n    const sql = &#96;\n      INSERT INTO brainstorm_sessions \n      (id, title, topic, description, creator_id, status, config, created_at, updated_at)\n      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'draft', ?, ?, ?)\n    &#96;;\n    \n    await this.db.query(sql, [\n      id,\n      data.title,\n      data.topic,\n      data.description || null,\n      data.creatorId || null,\n      JSON.stringify(config),\n      now,\n      now,\n    ]);\n\n    // 添加参与者\n    if (data.participantRoleIds.length &gt; 0) {\n      const participantModel = new BrainstormParticipantModel(this.db);\n      for (let i = 0; i &lt; data.participantRoleIds.length; i++) {\n        await participantModel.create({\n          sessionId: id,\n          aiRoleId: data.participantRoleIds[i],\n          sortOrder: i,\n        });\n      }\n    }\n\n    return this.getById(id);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据ID获取会话\n   */\n  async getById(id: string): Promise&lt;BrainstormSessionDTO&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      SELECT * FROM brainstorm_sessions WHERE id = ?\n    &#96;;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "// 页面配置\nconst PAGE_CONFIG = {\n  ai_qa: {\n    icon: Brain,\n    title: \"AI问答助手\",\n    welcomeMessage:\n      \"您好！我是AI问答助手，可以为您解答各种技术问题。请输入您的问题，我会为您提供详细的解答。\",\n    placeholder: \"请输入您的问题...\",\n    defaultInput: \"\",\n    buttonText: \"获取答案\",\n    loadingText: \"思考中...\",\n    responsePrefix: \"正在为您解答...\",\n    color: \"blue\",\n  },\n  tech_package: {\n    icon: Package,\n    title: \"技术包装助手\",\n    welcomeMessage:\n      \"您好！我是技术包装助手，专门为您提供专业的技术包装服务。请输入您的技术内容，我会为您生成精美的技术包装方案。\",\n    placeholder: \"请输入您的修改意见...\",\n    defaultInput: '请生成一份 关于 \"关联技术点\" 的  技术包装内容。',\n    buttonText: \"生成技术包装\",\n    loadingText: \"生成中...\",\n    responsePrefix: \"正在生成技术包装方案...\",\n    color: \"orange\",\n  },\n  promotion_strategy: {\n    icon: FileText,\n    title: \"推广策略助手\",\n    welcomeMessage:\n      \"您好！我是推广策略助手，专注于为您制定专业的推广发展策略。请描述您的推广需求，我会为您提供战略性建议。\",\n    placeholder: \"请描述您的修改意见...\",\n    defaultInput: \"\",\n    buttonText: \"生成推广策略\",\n    loadingText: \"策划中...\",\n    responsePrefix: \"正在制定推广策略...\",\n    color: \"purple\",\n  },\n  core_draft: {\n    icon: FileText,\n    title: \"核心稿件助手\",\n    welcomeMessage:\n      \"您好！我是核心稿件助手，专门为您撰写专业的核心稿件。请提供稿件要点，我会为您生成规范的稿件内容。\",\n    placeholder: \"请输入您的修改意见...\",\n    defaultInput: \"\",\n    buttonText: \"生成核心稿件\",\n    loadingText: \"撰写中...\",\n    responsePrefix: \"正在撰写核心稿件...\",\n    color: \"green\",\n  },\n  speech: {\n    icon: Megaphone,\n    title: \"演讲稿助手\",\n,\n};",

        "contents": "# 多Agent头脑风暴模式优化实施总结\n\n&gt; **实施时间**: 2026-01-12  \n&gt; **优先级**: P0（核心优化）+ P1（共识检测）+ P2（辩论模式）  \n&gt; **状态**: ✅ 全部完成\n\n---\n\n## 一、实施内容\n\n### 1.1 扩展配置模型\n\n**文件**: &#96;backend/src/models/Brainstorm.ts&#96;\n\n**新增配置项**:\n\n1. **反思循环配置** (&#96;ReflectionLoopConfig&#96;)\n   - &#96;enabled&#96;: 是否启用反思循环\n   - &#96;maxIterations&#96;: 最大迭代次数（默认3）\n   - &#96;qualityThreshold&#96;: 质量阈值 0-1（默认0.7）\n   - &#96;evaluatorRoleId&#96;: 评审Agent ID（可选）\n   - &#96;reflectorRoleId&#96;: 反思Agent ID（可选）\n   - &#96;reflectionFrequency&#96;: 每N轮进行一次反思（默认每3轮）\n\n2. **结构化上下文配置** (&#96;StructuredContextConfig&#96;)\n   - &#96;enabled&#96;: 是否启用结构化上下文\n   - &#96;summaryFrequency&#96;: 每N轮生成一次摘要（默认每3轮）\n   - &#96;summarizerRoleId&#96;: 摘要Agent ID（可选）\n   - &#96;extractKeyPoints&#96;: 是否提取关键观点\n   - &#96;detectDisagreements&#96;: 是否检测分歧点\n   - &#96;maxContextTokens&#96;: 最大上下文Token数（默认8000）\n\n**新增数据类型**:\n- &#96;StructuredContext&#96;: 结构化上下文数据\n- &#96;EvaluationResult&#96;: 评审结果\n- &#96;ReflectionResult&#96;: 反思结果\n\n---\n\n### 1.2 结构化上下文管理器\n\n**文件**: &#96;backend/src/services/brainstorm/StructuredContextManager.ts&#96;\n\n**核心功能**:\n- ✅ 将历史消息压缩为结构化摘要\n- ✅ 提取关键观点和支撑证据\n- ✅ 检测分歧点和共识\n- ✅ Token消耗估算和优化\n- ✅ 降级处理（Agent调用失败时）\n\n**关键方法**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nbuildStructuredContext(): Promise&lt;StructuredContext&gt;\nformatContextForAgent(): string\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**预期收益**:\n- Token消耗减少 **50-70%**\n- 上下文传递效率提升\n- 支持更长轮次的讨论\n\n---\n\n### 1.3 评审-反思循环管理器\n\n**文件**: &#96;backend/src/services/brainstorm/ReflectionLoopManager.ts&#96;\n\n**核心功能**:\n- ✅ 自动评审讨论质量（5个维度）\n- ✅ 生成改进建议\n- ✅ 反思分析\n- ✅ 迭代优化控制",

        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = ({ \n  config, \n  embeddedMode = false,\n  projectId: propProjectId,\n  hideTopNavigation = false \n}) =&gt; {\n  const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams();\n  const [sources, setSources] = useState&lt;Source[]&gt;([]);\n  const [selectedSourceIds, setSelectedSourceIds] = useState&lt;string[]&gt;([]);\n  // 追踪当前对话中已发送给 Dify 的来源 ID，避免重复发送\n  const [sentSourceIds, setSentSourceIds] = useState&lt;string[]&gt;([]);\n  const [conversations, setConversations] = useState&lt;Conversation[]&gt;([]);\n  const [currentConversation, setCurrentConversation] = useState&lt;Conversation | null&gt;(null);\n  const [outputs, setOutputs] = useState&lt;OutputContent[]&gt;([]);\n  const [showSourceSidebar, setShowSourceSidebar] = useState(true); // 默认显示左侧边栏\n  const [showStudioSidebar, setShowStudioSidebar] = useState(config.pageType === 'tech-package'); // tech-package 页面默认显示右侧边栏（工具箱和聊天历史）\n  const [workflowConfig, setWorkflowConfig] = useState&lt;WorkflowConfig | null&gt;(null);\n  const [showFieldMappingConfig, setShowFieldMappingConfig] = useState(false);\n  const [triggeringFeatureId, setTriggeringFeatureId] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n  const [triggeringStatus, setTriggeringStatus] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n  const [availableWorkflows, setAvailableWorkflows] = useState&lt;AgentWorkflow[]&gt;([]);\n  const [isWorkflowLoading, setIsWorkflowLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [selectedWorkflowId, setSelectedWorkflowId] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n  const [contextWindowSize, setContextWindowSize] = useState&lt;number&gt;(10);\n  const [isLoadingMoreMessages, setIsLoadingMoreMessages] = useState(false);\n  const [globalError, setGlobalError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n  const [globalErrorDetail, setGlobalErrorDetail] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n  const [enabledToolIds, setEnabledToolIds] = useState&lt;string[] | undefined&gt;(config.enabledToolIds);\n  const [dynamicLabelMap, setDynamicLabelMap] = useState&lt;Record&lt;string, string&gt;&gt;({});\n  const [project, setProject] = useState;\n;",

        "contents": "export const PRESET_ROLES: Record&lt;string, Partial&lt;AIRoleConfig&gt;&gt; = {\n\n  'ai-qa-assistant': {\n    name: 'AI问答助手',\n    description: '基于项目资源进行智能问答，支持文件、技术点和知识库的检索。',\n    provider: 'direct-agent',\n    agentConfig: {\n      llm: {\n        provider: 'openai',\n        model: 'gpt-4o',\n        temperature: 0.5,\n        maxTokens: 2000,\n        apiKey: 'sk-placeholder-please-update',\n      },\n      prompt: {\n        systemPrompt: &#96;你是一个智能问答助手，专门基于用户提供的项目资源（文件、技术点、知识库）回答问题。\n\n**你的职责：**\n1. 仔细阅读用户提供的上下文信息。\n2. 准确、简洁地回答用户的问题。\n3. 如果答案在提供的资源中找不到，请诚实地说明，不要编造。\n4. 引用资源时，尽量注明来源。\n\n**回答风格：**\n专业、客观、有条理。&#96;,\n      },\n      contextStrategy: DEFAULT_CONTEXT_STRATEGY\n    }\n  }\n};\n\nexport const createPresetRole = async (featureType: string)\n;",

        "contents": "const BrainstormPage: React.FC = \nconst handleStopSession = async \n\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleDeleteSession = async (sessionId: string) =&gt; {\n    if (!confirm('确定要删除这个会话吗？')) return;\n\n    try {\n      await brainstormService.deleteSession(sessionId);\n      setSessions(sessions.filter(s =&gt; s.id !== sessionId));\n      if (selectedSession?.id === sessionId) {\n        setSelectedSession(null);\n        setMessages([]);\n      }\n      toast.success('会话已删除');\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('删除会话失败:', error);\n      toast.error('删除会话失败');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleSendUserMessage = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!selectedSession || !userInput.trim() || sendingUserMessage) return;\n\n    try {\n      setSendingUserMessage(true);\n      const message = await brainstormService.addUserMessage(\n        selectedSession.id,\n        userInput.trim()\n      );\n      setUserInput('');\n      setMessages([...messages, message]);\n      toast.success('消息已发送');\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('发送用户消息失败:', error);\n      toast.error(error instanceof Error ?           "endPosition": {
            "line": 907,
            "column": 1
          }
        },
        "contents": "export class BrainstormOrchestrator {\nprivate async runDiscussionLoop(sessionId: string): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\nwhile (this.activeSessions.get(sessionId)) {\n\n\n      // 执行一轮讨论（带超时保护）\n      try {\n        await Promise.race([\n          this.executeRound(sessionId, roundNumber),\n          new Promise((_, reject) =&gt; \n            setTimeout(() =&gt; reject(new Error('轮次执行超时')), MAX_ROUND_TIME)\n          )\n        ]);\n        consecutiveErrors = 0; // 重置错误计数\n\n        // 检查是否需要执行反思循环\n        const session = await brainstormSessionModel.getById(sessionId);\n        if (session.config.reflectionLoop?.enabled &amp;&amp; \n            roundNumber &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; \n            roundNumber % (session.config.reflectionLoop.reflectionFrequency || 3) === 0) {\n          await this.executeReflectionIfNeeded(sessionId, roundNumber);\n        }\n      } catch (error) {\n        consecutiveErrors++;\n        console.error(&#96;轮次 ${roundNumber} 执行失败:&#96;, error);\n        \n        // 如果连续错误过多，停止讨论\n        if (consecutiveErrors &gt;= MAX_CONSECUTIVE_ERRORS) {\n          console.error(&#96;连续 ${consecutiveErrors} 次错误，停止讨论&#96;);\n          await brainstormSessionModel.update(sessionId, { \n            status: 'stopped',\n            summary: &#96;讨论因连续错误而停止：${error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'}&#96;\n          });\n          break;\n        }\n        \n        // 继续下一轮，但记录错误\n        try {\n          await brainstormMessageModel.create({\n            sessionId,\n            participantId: null,\n            roundNumber,\n            content: &#96;[系统] 第 ${roundNumber} 轮讨论执行失败，已跳过。错误：${error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'}&#96;,\n            messageType: 'agent',\n            metadata: { error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误', isSystemMessage: true },\n          });\n        } catch (saveError) {\n          console.error('保存错误消息失败:', saveError);\n        }\n      }\n\n      // 检查轮次超时\n      const roundElapsed = Date.now() - roundStartTime;\n      if (roundElapsed &gt; MAX_ROUND_TIME) {\n        console.warn(&#96;轮次 ${roundNumber} 超时，停止讨论&#96;);\n    }\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class BrainstormOrchestrator {\nprivate async executeRoundRobin(\n    session: BrainstormSessionDTO,\n    participants: BrainstormParticipantDTO[],\n    roundNumber: number\n  ): Promise&lt;BrainstormMessageDTO[]&gt; {\nfor (let i = 0; i &lt; sortedParticipants.length; i++) {\n\n\n      try {\n        const AGENT_TIMEOUT = 300000; // 单个 Agent 5分钟超时\n        const result = await Promise.race([\n          this.agentOrchestrator.executeAgent(\n            participant.aiRoleId,\n            query,\n            conversationId,\n            {\n              topic: session.topic,\n              description: session.description,\n              roundNumber,\n              participantName: participant.displayName || participant.aiRole?.name || '专家',\n              turnIndex: i,\n              totalTurns: sortedParticipants.length,\n            }\n          ),\n          new Promise&lt;never&gt;((_, reject) =&gt; \n            setTimeout(() =&gt; reject(new Error('Agent 执行超时')), AGENT_TIMEOUT)\n          )\n        ]);\n\n        // 保存消息\n        const message = await brainstormMessageModel.create({\n          sessionId: session.id,\n          participantId: participant.id,\n          roundNumber,\n          content: result.content,\n          metadata: {\n            promptTokens: result.usage.promptTokens,\n            completionTokens: result.usage.completionTokens,\n            totalTokens: result.usage.totalTokens,\n            model: result.metadata?.model,\n            finishReason: result.metadata?.finishReason,\n          },\n        });\n        \n        messages.push(message);\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error(&#96;参与者 ${participant.id} 执行失败:&#96;, error);\n        // 返回错误消息\n        const errorMessage = await brainstormMessageModel.create({\n          sessionId: session.id,\n          participantId: participant.id,\n          roundNumber,\n          content: &#96;抱歉，我在思考这个问题时遇到了困难。${error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'}&#96;,\n          metadata: {\n            error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误',\n            timeout: error instanceof Error &amp;&amp; error.message.includes('超时'),\n          },\n        });\n        messages.push(errorMessage);\n      }\n    }\n\n    return messages;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class BrainstormOrchestrator {\nprivate async executeParallel(\n    session: BrainstormSessionDTO,\n    participants: BrainstormParticipantDTO[],\n    roundNumber: number\n  ): Promise&lt;BrainstormMessageDTO[]&gt; {\nconst agentPromises = async (participant, index) =&gt; {\n\n\n      try {\n        const result = await Promise.race([\n          this.agentOrchestrator.executeAgent(\n            participant.aiRoleId,\n            query,\n            conversationId,\n            {\n              topic: session.topic,\n              description: session.description,\n              roundNumber,\n              participantName: participant.displayName || participant.aiRole?.name || '专家',\n            }\n          ),\n          new Promise&lt;never&gt;((_, reject) =&gt; \n            setTimeout(() =&gt; reject(new Error('Agent 执行超时')), AGENT_TIMEOUT)\n          )\n        ]);\n\n        // 保存消息（使用事务确保数据一致性）\n        return await brainstormMessageModel.create({\n          sessionId: session.id,\n          participantId: participant.id,\n          roundNumber,\n          content: result.content,\n          metadata: {\n            promptTokens: result.usage.promptTokens,\n            completionTokens: result.usage.completionTokens,\n            totalTokens: result.usage.totalTokens,\n            model: result.metadata?.model,\n            finishReason: result.metadata?.finishReason,\n          },\n        });\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error(&#96;参与者 ${participant.id} 执行失败:&#96;, error);\n        // 返回错误消息\n        return await brainstormMessageModel.create({\n          sessionId: session.id,\n          participantId: participant.id,\n          roundNumber,\n          content: &#96;抱歉，我在思考这个问题时遇到了困难。${error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'}&#96;,\n          metadata: {\n            error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误',\n            timeout: error instanceof Error &amp;&amp; error.message.includes('超时'),\n          },\n        });\n      }\n    });\n\n    // 等待所有 Agent 完成（使用 allSettled 避免单个失败影响整体）\n    const results = await Promise.allSettled(agentPromises);\n    const messages: BrainstormMessageDTO[] = [];\n\n    for (const result of results) {\n      if (result.status === 'fulfilled')\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "import {\n  brainstormSessionModel,\n  brainstormParticipantModel,\n  brainstormMessageModel,\n  aiRoleModel,\n} from '../../models';\nimport {\n  BrainstormSessionDTO,\n  CreateBrainstormSessionDTO,\n  UpdateBrainstormSessionDTO,\n  BrainstormParticipantDTO,\n  AddParticipantDTO,\n  BrainstormMessageDTO,\n} from '../../models/Brainstorm';\n\n/**\n * 头脑风暴业务服务\n */\nexport class BrainstormService {\n  /**\n   * 创建会话\n   */\n  async createSession(data: CreateBrainstormSessionDTO): Promise&lt;BrainstormSessionDTO&gt; {\n    // 验证参与者角色是否存在\n    for (const roleId of data.participantRoleIds) {\n      const role = await aiRoleModel.getById(roleId);\n      if (!role) {\n        throw new Error(&#96;AI角色不存在: ${roleId}&#96;);\n      }\n      if (!role.enabled) {\n        throw new Error(&#96;AI角色未启用: ${roleId}&#96;);\n      }\n    }\n\n    const session = await brainstormSessionModel.create(data);\n    \n    // 加载参与者信息\n    const participants = await brainstormParticipantModel.getBySessionId(session.id);\n    session.participants = participants;\n    \n    return session;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取会话列表\n   */\n  async listSessions(options: {\n    creatorId?: string;\n    status?: string;\n    limit?: number;\n    offset?: number;\n  } = {}): Promise&lt;BrainstormSessionDTO[]&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "const BrainstormPage: React.FC = \n\n\n  const handleCreateSession = async (data: CreateBrainstormSessionDTO) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const session = await brainstormService.createSession(data);\n      setSessions([session, ...sessions]);\n      setSelectedSession(session);\n      setIsSetupModalOpen(false);\n      toast.success('会话创建成功');\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('创建会话失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleStartSession = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!selectedSession) return;\n\n    try {\n      await brainstormService.startSession(selectedSession.id);\n      toast.success('讨论已启动');\n      // 重新加载会话状态\n      const updated = await brainstormService.getSession(selectedSession.id);\n      setSelectedSession(updated);\n      startPolling(selectedSession.id);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('启动讨论失败:', error);\n      toast.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : '启动讨论失败');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleStopSession = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!selectedSession) return;\n\n    try {\n      await brainstormService.stopSession(selectedSession.id);\n      toast.success('讨论已停止');\n      stopPolling();\n      // 重新加载会话状态\n      const updated = await brainstormService.getSession(selectedSession.id);\n      setSelectedSession(updated);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('停止讨论失败:', error);\n      toast.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : '停止讨论失败');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleDeleteSession = async (sessionId: string) =&gt;\n;\n;",

        "contents": "export const brainstormService = {\n,\n\n  /**\n   * 获取会话列表\n   */\n  async listSessions(options: {\n    creatorId?: string;\n    status?: string;\n    limit?: number;\n    offset?: number;\n  } = {}): Promise&lt;BrainstormSession[]&gt; {\n    const params = new URLSearchParams();\n    if (options.creatorId) params.append(\"creatorId\", options.creatorId);\n    if (options.status) params.append(\"status\", options.status);\n    if (options.limit) params.append(\"limit\", options.limit.toString());\n    if (options.offset) params.append(\"offset\", options.offset.toString());\n\n    const response = await apiClient.get&lt;ApiResponse&lt;BrainstormSession[]&gt;&gt;(\n      &#96;/brainstorm/sessions?${params.toString()}&#96;\n    );\n    if (!response.success || !response.data) {\n      throw new Error(response.error || response.message || \"获取会话列表失败\");\n    }\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * 获取会话详情\n   */\n  async getSession(id: string): Promise&lt;BrainstormSession&gt; {\n    const response = await apiClient.get\n;\n  }\n,\n};",

            "column": 1

        },
        "contents": "export class BrainstormMessageModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取会话的所有消息\n   */\n  async getBySessionId(\n    sessionId: string,\n    options: {\n      roundNumber?: number;\n      afterMessageId?: string;\n      limit?: number;\n    } = {}\n  ): Promise&lt;BrainstormMessageDTO[]&gt; {\n    let sql = &#96;\n      SELECT m.*, p.ai_role_id, p.display_name, p.role_type\n      FROM brainstorm_messages m\n      LEFT JOIN brainstorm_participants p ON m.participant_id = p.id\n      WHERE m.session_id = ?\n    &#96;;\n    const params: any[] = [sessionId];\n\n    if (options.roundNumber !== undefined) {\n      sql += ' AND m.round_number = ?';\n      params.push(options.roundNumber);\n    }\n\n    if (options.afterMessageId) {\n      sql += ' AND m.created_at &gt; (SELECT created_at FROM brainstorm_messages WHERE id = ?)';\n      params.push(options.afterMessageId);\n    }\n\n    sql += ' ORDER BY m.round_number ASC, m.created_at ASC';\n\n    if (options.limit) {\n      sql += ' LIMIT ?';\n      params.push(options.limit);\n    }\n\n    const rows = await this.db.query(sql, params);\n    return rows.map((row: any) =&gt; this.toDTO(row));\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取会话的最大轮次\n   */\n  async getMaxRoundNumber(sessionId: string): Promise&lt;number&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      SELECT MAX(round_number) as max_round\n      FROM brainstorm_messages\n      WHERE session_id = ?\n    &#96;;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class DebateModeManager {\nprivate async executeSideTurn(\n    session: BrainstormSessionDTO,\n    participants: BrainstormParticipantDTO[],\n    side: 'pro' | 'con',\n    roundNumber: number,\n    historyMessages: BrainstormMessageDTO[],\n    instruction: string\n  ): Promise&lt;BrainstormMessageDTO[]&gt; {\nconst promises = async (participant) =&gt; {\n {\n        console.error(&#96;辩论参与者 ${participant.id} 执行失败:&#96;, error);\n        return await brainstormMessageModel.create({\n          sessionId: session.id,\n          participantId: participant.id,\n          roundNumber,\n          content: &#96;抱歉，我在思考这个问题时遇到了困难。${error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'}&#96;,\n          metadata: {\n            error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误',\n            debateSide: side,\n          },\n        });\n      }\n    });\n\n    const results = await Promise.allSettled(promises);\n    for (const result of results) {\n      if (result.status === 'fulfilled') {\n        messages.push(result.value);\n      }\n    }\n\n    return messages;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 构建辩论查询\n   */\n  private buildDebateQuery(\n    session: BrainstormSessionDTO,\n    participant: BrainstormParticipantDTO,\n    side: 'pro' | 'con',\n    roundNumber: number,\n    historyMessages: BrainstormMessageDTO[],\n    instruction: string\n  ): string {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class BrainstormOrchestrator {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 启动讨论会话\n   */\n  async startSession(sessionId: string): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    // 检查会话是否存在\n    const session = await brainstormSessionModel.getById(sessionId);\n    \n    if (session.status === 'active') {\n      throw new Error('会话已在运行中');\n    }\n\n    if (session.status === 'completed' || session.status === 'stopped') {\n      throw new Error('会话已结束，无法重新启动');\n    }\n\n    // 检查参与者\n    const participants = await brainstormParticipantModel.getBySessionId(sessionId);\n    if (participants.length === 0) {\n      throw new Error('会话没有参与者');\n    }\n\n    // 更新状态为 active\n    await brainstormSessionModel.update(sessionId, { status: 'active' });\n    this.activeSessions.set(sessionId, true);\n\n    try {\n      // 开始讨论循环\n      await this.runDiscussionLoop(sessionId);\n    } catch (error) {\n      // 发生错误时停止会话\n      await brainstormSessionModel.update(sessionId, { status: 'stopped' });\n      this.activeSessions.delete(sessionId);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 停止讨论会话\n   */\n  async stopSession(sessionId: string): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    this.activeSessions.set(sessionId, false);\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "const BrainstormPage: React.FC = \n\n\n  // 加载来源信息（根据是否有 projectId 选择不同的查询方式）\n  const loadSources = useCallback(async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      setLoadingSources(true);\n      let result;\n      \n      if (projectId) {\n        // 如果有项目ID，使用项目级查询\n        const projectIdNum = parseInt(projectId);\n        if (!isNaN(projectIdNum)) {\n          result = await sourceService.loadSourceInformationByProjectId(projectIdNum);\n        } else {\n          console.warn('[BrainstormPage] 无效的项目ID:', projectId);\n          return;\n        }\n      } else {\n        // 如果没有项目ID，使用页面类型查询\n        result = await sourceService.loadSourceInformationByPageType('tech-strategy');\n      }\n      \n      if (result.success &amp;&amp; result.data) {\n        setSources(result.data);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载来源信息失败:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setLoadingSources(false);\n    }\n  }, [projectId]);\n\n  // 加载项目信息\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const loadProject = async () =&gt; {\n      if (projectId) {\n        const projectIdNum = parseInt(projectId);\n        if (!isNaN(projectIdNum)) {\n          try {\n            const result = await projectService.getProjectById(projectIdNum);\n            if (result.success &amp;&amp; result.data) {\n              setProject(result.data);\n            }\n          } catch (error) {\n            console.error('加载项目信息失败:', error);\n          }\n        }\n      } else {\n        setProject(null);\n      }\n    };\n    loadProject();\n  }, [projectId]);\n\n  // 加载会话列表\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    loadSessions();\n    loadSources();\n  }, [loadSources]);\n\n  // 当选中会话变化时，加载消息\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    if (selectedSession) {\n      loadMessages(selectedSession.id);\n      startPolling(selectedSession.id);\n    } else {\n      stopPolling();\n    }\n\n    return () =&gt; {\n      stopPolling();\n    };\n  }, [selectedSession?.id]);\n\n  const loadSessions = async () =&gt; {\n    try\n;\n;",

        "contents": "export class BrainstormOrchestrator {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 执行讨论循环\n   */\n  private async runDiscussionLoop(sessionId: string): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    let roundNumber = 1;\n    const MAX_ROUND_TIME = 600000; // 10分钟整轮超时\n    const MAX_TOTAL_TIME = 3600000; // 1小时总超时\n    const sessionStartTime = Date.now();\n    let consecutiveErrors = 0;\n    const MAX_CONSECUTIVE_ERRORS = 3; // 最多连续3次错误后停止\n\n    while (this.activeSessions.get(sessionId)) {\n      const roundStartTime = Date.now();\n\n      // 检查总超时\n      const totalElapsed = Date.now() - sessionStartTime;\n      if (totalElapsed &gt; MAX_TOTAL_TIME) {\n        console.warn(&#96;会话 ${sessionId} 总超时，停止讨论&#96;);\n        await brainstormSessionModel.update(sessionId, { status: 'stopped' });\n        break;\n      }\n\n      // 检查是否应该停止\n      const shouldStop = await this.shouldStop(sessionId);\n      if (shouldStop.stop) {\n        console.log(&#96;会话 ${sessionId} 停止: ${shouldStop.reason}&#96;);\n        break;\n      }\n\n      // 检查共识检测（如果启用）\n      if (roundNumber &gt; 1 &amp;&amp; roundNumber % 2 === 0) { // 每2轮检查一次\n        const consensusResult = await this.checkConsensus(sessionId, roundNumber);\n        if (consensusResult?.hasConsensus) {\n          console.log(&#96;会话 ${sessionId} 达成共识，停止讨论&#96;);\n          await brainstormMessageModel.create({\n            sessionId,\n            participantId: null,\n            roundNumber,\n            content: &#96;[共识检测] 讨论已达成共识（置信度：${(consensusResult.confidence * 100).toFixed(1)}%）\\n共识主题：${consensusResult.consensusTopics.join('、')}&#96;,\n            messageType: 'agent',\n            metadata: {\n              consensusResult,\n              isSystemMessage: true,\n            },\n          });\n          await brainstormSessionModel.update(sessionId, {\n            status: 'completed',\n            summary: &#96;讨论达成共识。共识主题：${consensusResult.consensusTopics.join('、')}&#96;,\n          });\n          break;\n        }\n      }\n\n      // 执行一轮讨论（带超时保护）\n    }\n  }\n}",

{\n\n    \n    try {\n      // 1. 获取 Agent 配置\n      checkTimeout();\n      await this.logStep(executionId, 'load_config', {\n        type: 'config',\n        input: { roleId },\n        output: null,\n        duration: 0,\n        status: 'success'\n      });\n\n      const role = await aiRoleModel.getById(roleId);\n      if (!role) {\n        throw new Error(&#96;AI角色不存在: ${roleId}&#96;);\n      }\n\n      if (!role.agentConfig) {\n        throw new Error(&#96;Agent配置不存在: ${roleId}&#96;);\n      }\n\n      const config = role.agentConfig;\n\n      // 2. 生成或使用 conversationId\n      const finalConversationId = conversationId || this.generateConversationId();\n\n      // 3. 渲染 System Prompt\n      const promptStartTime = Date.now();\n      const systemPrompt = this.promptManager.renderPrompt(\n        config.prompt.systemPrompt,\n        config.prompt.variables || [],\n        context\n      );\n      await this.logStep(executionId, 'render_prompt', {\n        type: 'prompt',\n        input: { systemPrompt: config.prompt.systemPrompt, variables: config.prompt.variables, context },\n        output: { systemPrompt },\n        duration: Date.now() - promptStartTime,\n        status: 'success'\n      });\n\n      // 4. 获取上下文消息\n      checkTimeout();\n      const contextStartTime = Date.now();\n      const contextMessages = await this.contextManager.getContextMessages(\n        finalConversationId,\n        config.contextStrategy,\n        query\n      );\n      await this.logStep(executionId, 'load_context', {\n        type: 'context',\n        input: { conversationId: finalConversationId, strategy: config.contextStrategy, query },\n        output: { messageCount: contextMessages.length },\n        duration: Date.now() - contextStartTime,\n        status: 'success'\n      });\n\n      // 5. 构建完整消息列表\n      const messages: ChatMessage[] = [];\n      \n      // 根据策略决定是否包含 system prompt\n      if\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "// Direct Agent配置\nexport interface DirectAgentConfig {\n  // LLM基础配置\n  llm: {\n    provider: 'openai' | 'azure-openai' | 'qwen' | 'ernie' | 'custom';\n    apiKey: string;\n    apiBaseUrl?: string;  // 自定义端点\n    model: string;        // gpt-4, gpt-3.5-turbo, qwen-max等\n    temperature: number;  // 0-2\n    maxTokens: number;    // 最大生成token数\n    topP?: number;        // 0-1\n    stream?: boolean;     // 是否使用流式响应\n  };\n  \n  // Prompt配置\n  prompt: {\n    systemPrompt: string;           // 系统提示词\n    variables?: PromptVariable[];   // 动态变量\n    templates?: PromptTemplate[];   // 预设模板\n  };\n  \n  // 上下文管理策略\n  contextStrategy: {\n    type: 'window' | 'summary' | 'hybrid';  // 窗口/摘要/混合\n    maxMessages: number;                     // 最大历史消息数\n    maxTokens: number;                       // 最大上下文token数\n    summaryThreshold?: number;               // 触发摘要的消息数阈值\n    includeSystemPrompt: boolean;            // 是否每次都包含system prompt\n  };\n  \n  // 工具调用配置\n  tools?: ToolConfig[];\n  \n  // Agent协作配置\n  agentCalls?: AgentCallConfig[];\n}\n\nexport interface AIRoleConfig {\n  id: string;                    // 唯一标识\n  name: string\n;\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./backend/src/services/agent/AgentOrchestrator.ts",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 29
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 727,
            "column": 1
          }
        },
        "contents": "export class AgentOrchestrator {\nasync executeAgent(\n    roleId: string,\n    query: string,\n    conversationId: string = '',\n    context: Record&lt;string, any&gt; = {}\n  ): Promise&lt;AgentExecutionResult&gt; {\n\n      \n      // 根据策略决定是否包含 system prompt\n      if (config.contextStrategy.includeSystemPrompt || contextMessages.length === 0) {\n        messages.push({\n          role: 'system',\n          content: systemPrompt\n        });\n      }\n\n      messages.push(...contextMessages);\n      messages.push({\n        role: 'user',\n        content: query\n      });\n\n      // 6. 准备工具定义（Function Calling）\n      const tools = this.prepareTools(config.tools || []);\n\n      // 7. 获取 LLM Provider\n      const provider = this.getProvider(config.llm);\n\n      // 8. 调用 LLM（可能包含多轮工具调用）\n      checkTimeout();\n      const llmStartTime = Date.now();\n      let response = await this.executeWithTools(provider, messages, config.llm, tools, config.tools || [], checkTimeout, executionId);\n      const llmDuration = Date.now() - llmStartTime;\n      \n      // 记录性能指标\n      await this.recordPerformanceMetrics(executionId, 'llm_call', llmDuration, response.usage);\n      \n      await this.logStep(executionId, 'llm_call', {\n        type: 'llm',\n        input: { messageCount: messages.length, toolCount: tools.length },\n        output: { content: response.content, toolCalls: response.toolCalls?.length || 0 },\n        duration: llmDuration,\n        status: 'success'\n      });\n\n      // 9. 保存消息历史\n      await this.saveMessages(finalConversationId, query, response, roleId);\n\n      // 10. 返回结果\n      const totalDuration = Date.now() - startTime;\n      \n      // 记录总体执行时间\n      await this.recordPerformanceMetrics(executionId, 'execution_time', totalDuration, { \n        roleId, \n        toolCalls: response.toolCalls?.length || 0 \n      });\n      \n      await this.logStep(executionId, 'complete', {\n        type: 'complete',\n        input: { query },\n        output: { content: response.content },\n        duration: totalDuration,\n        status: 'success'\n      });\n\n      return\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "import aiRoleService from '../services/aiRoleService';\n\nconst DEFAULT_CONTEXT_STRATEGY: DirectAgentConfig['contextStrategy'] = {\n  type: 'window',\n  maxMessages: 20,\n  maxTokens: 4000,\n  includeSystemPrompt: true\n};\n\nexport const PRESET_ROLES: Record&lt;string, Partial&lt;AIRoleConfig&gt;&gt; = {\n  'five-view-analysis': {\n    name: '技术转译（五看）助手',\n    description: '用于进行\"五看\"（看行业、看市场、看客户、看竞争、看自己）分析。',\n    provider: 'direct-agent',\n    agentConfig: {\n      llm: {\n        provider: 'openai',\n        model: 'gpt-4o',\n        temperature: 0.7,\n        maxTokens: 2000,\n        apiKey: 'sk-placeholder-please-update',\n      },\n      prompt: {\n        systemPrompt: &#96;你是一位战略分析专家，擅长使用\"五看\"方法论进行深度分析。\n\n你的任务是根据输入的信息，进行以下五个维度的分析：\n1. **看行业 (Industry)**: 行业趋势、政策导向、技术变革。\n2. **看市场 (Market)**: 市场规模、增长潜力、细分领域。\n3. **看客户 (Customer)**: 客户画像、痛点需求、购买行为。\n4. **看竞争 (Competition)**: 竞争格局、主要对手、SWOT分析。\n5. **看自己 (Self)**: 自身优势、短板、核心竞争力。\n\n请输出结构化的分析报告，并给出战略建议。&#96;,\n      },\n      contextStrategy: DEFAULT_CONTEXT_STRATEGY\n    }\n  },\n  'three-fix-analysis': {\n    name: '用户场景挖掘（三定）助手',\n};",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "export class AIRoleModel {\nprivate toAIRoleConfig(row: AIRole): AIRoleConfig {\n\n    \n    if (provider === 'direct-agent') {\n      // Direct Agent 配置\n      // 支持两种格式：{ provider: 'direct-agent', agentConfig: {...} } 或直接是 agentConfig\n      if (configData.agentConfig &amp;&amp; typeof configData.agentConfig === 'object') {\n        agentConfig = configData.agentConfig as DirectAgentConfig;\n      } else if (configData.llm &amp;&amp; typeof configData.llm === 'object') {\n        // 旧格式：直接包含 llm, prompt, contextStrategy 等\n        agentConfig = configData as DirectAgentConfig;\n      }\n    } else {\n      // Dify 配置（向后兼容）\n      // 检查是否包含 Dify 必需的字段，或者如果 configData 不为空，假设是 Dify 配置\n      if (configData &amp;&amp; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class AgentNodeExecutor implements NodeExecutor {\nasync execute(node: any, context: Record&lt;string, any&gt;): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n\n    }\n    \n    // Dify Agent 类型的原有逻辑\n    if (!role.difyConfig) throw new Error(&#96;AI角色 ${agentId} 的Dify配置不存在&#96;);\n    const { connectionType, apiKey, apiUrl } = role.difyConfig;\n    let actualBaseUrl = apiUrl;\n    if (apiUrl.startsWith('/')) actualBaseUrl = process.env.DIFY_BASE_URL || 'http://47.113.225.93:9999/v1';\n    const gateway = new DifyGateway({ baseUrl: actualBaseUrl, workflowBaseUrl: actualBaseUrl, apiKey, timeout: 60000, maxRetries: 3 });\n    const nodeInput = { ...context, ...(node.data?.inputs || {}) };\n    let query = nodeInput.query || nodeInput.input || nodeInput.workflowInput?.query || nodeInput.question || nodeInput.text || nodeInput.content;\n    if (!query) query = typeof nodeInput === 'string' ? nodeInput : JSON.stringify(nodeInput);\n    const inputs = { ...nodeInput };\n    delete inputs.query;\n    delete inputs.input;\n    if (connectionType === 'chatflow') {\n      const result = await gateway.executeChat({ query, conversationId: '', inputs, userId: 'todify3-user' });\n      if ((result as any).ok || (result as any).value) {\n        const raw = (result as any).value?.raw ?? (result as any).raw;\n        return { answer: raw?.answer || (result as any).value?.answer, conversation_id: raw?.conversation_id, raw };\n      }\n      throw new Error((result as any).error?.message || 'Dify聊天调用失败');\n    } else {\n      const result = await gateway.executeWorkflow({ workflowId: 'workflow', inputs, userId: 'todify3-user' });\n      if ((result as any).ok || (result as any).value) {\n        const raw = (result as any).value?.raw ??         "contents": "import { aiRoleModel } from '../../../models';\nimport { DifyGateway } from '@/shared/infrastructure/integrations/dify';\nimport { AgentOrchestrator } from '../../agent/AgentOrchestrator';\n\n/**\n * Agent节点执行器\n */\nexport class AgentNodeExecutor implements NodeExecutor {\n  async execute(node: any, context: Record&lt;string, any&gt;): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    const agentId = node.agentId || node.data?.agentId;\n    if (!agentId) throw new Error(&#96;Agent节点 ${node.id} 未配置agentId&#96;);\n    \n    const role = await aiRoleModel.getById(agentId);\n    if (!role) throw new Error(&#96;AI角色不存在: ${agentId}&#96;);\n    if (!role.enabled) throw new Error(&#96;AI角色已禁用: ${agentId}&#96;);\n    \n    const provider = role.provider || 'dify';\n    \n    // 支持 Direct Agent 类型\n    if (provider === 'direct-agent') {\n      if (!role.agentConfig) {\n        throw new Error(&#96;AI角色 ${agentId} 的Direct Agent配置不存在&#96;);\n      }\n      \n      // 使用 AgentOrchestrator 执行 Direct Agent\n      const orchestrator = new AgentOrchestrator();\n      const nodeInput = { ...context, ...(node.data?.inputs || {}) };\n      let query = nodeInput.query || nodeInput.input || nodeInput.workflowInput?.query || nodeInput.question || nodeInput.text || nodeInput.content;\n      if (!query) {\n        query = typeof nodeInput === 'string' ? nodeInput : JSON.stringify(nodeInput);\n      }\n      \n      // 从 sharedContext 中提取可用作 context 的数据\n      const agentContext: Record&lt;string, any&gt; = {};\n      Object.keys(nodeInput).forEach(key =&gt; {\n        if (key !== 'query' &amp;&amp; key !== 'input' &amp;&amp; key !== 'workflowInput') {\n          agentContext[key] = nodeInput[key];\n        }\n      });\n      \n      const result = await orchestrator.executeAgent(agentId, query, '', agentContext);\n      \n      return {\n        answer: result.content,\n        result: result.content,\n        conversation_id: result.conversationId,\n        raw: result\n      };\n    }\n    \n    // Dify Agent 类型的原有逻辑\n    if (!role.difyConfig)\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Prompt 管理服务\n * 负责渲染 Prompt，替换变量等\n */\nexport class PromptManager {\n  /**\n   * 渲染 Prompt（替换变量）\n   * @param template Prompt 模板字符串\n   * @param variables 变量定义列表\n   * @param context 上下文数据\n   * @returns 渲染后的 Prompt\n   */\n  renderPrompt(\n    template: string,\n    variables: PromptVariable[],\n    context: Record&lt;string, any&gt;\n  ): string {\n    if (!variables || variables.length === 0) {\n      return template;\n    }\n\n    let rendered = template;\n\n    for (const variable of variables) {\n      const value = this.resolveVariable(variable, context);\n      // 支持 {{variable}} 和 {variable} 两种格式\n      const patterns = [\n        new RegExp(&#96;\\\\{\\\\{${this.escapeRegex(variable.name)}\\\\}\\\\}&#96;, 'g'),\n        new RegExp(&#96;\\\\{${this.escapeRegex(variable.name)}\\\\}&#96;, 'g')\n      ];\n      \n      for (const pattern of patterns) {\n        rendered = rendered.replace(pattern, value);\n      }\n    }\n\n    return rendered;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 解析变量值\n   * @param variable 变量定义\n   * @param context 上下文数据\n   * @returns 变量值\n   */\n}",
        "signatures": {},

        },
        "contents": "export class GoogleProvider implements ILLMProvider {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 发送聊天请求\n   */\n  async chat(messages: ChatMessage[], config: LLMConfig, tools?: Tool[]): Promise&lt;LLMResponse&gt; {\n    const url = &#96;${this.apiBaseUrl}/models/${config.model}:generateContent?key=${this.apiKey}&#96;;\n\n    // 转换消息格式为 Gemini 格式\n    const contents = messages\n      .filter(msg =&gt; msg.role !== 'system') // Gemini 不支持 system 消息\n      .map(msg =&gt; {\n        if (msg.role === 'tool') {\n          // Gemini 使用 function_response 处理工具响应\n          return {\n            role: 'model',\n            parts: [{\n              functionResponse: {\n                name: msg.name,\n                response: JSON.parse(msg.content || '{}')\n              }\n            }]\n          };\n        }\n        return {\n          role: msg.role === 'assistant' ? 'model' : 'user',\n          parts: [{ text: msg.content }]\n        };\n      });\n\n    // 添加 system instruction（作为第一条消息的指令）\n    const systemMessages = messages.filter(m =&gt; m.role === 'system');\n    let systemInstruction: string | undefined;\n    if (systemMessages.length &gt; 0) {\n      systemInstruction = systemMessages.map(m =&gt; m.content).join('\\n');\n    }\n\n    // 转换工具为 Gemini 格式\n    let toolsConfig: any = undefined;\n    if (tools &amp;&amp; tools.length &gt; 0) {\n      toolsConfig = {\n        function_declarations: tools.map(tool =&gt; ({\n          name: tool.function.name,\n          description: tool.function.description,\n          parameters: tool.function.parameters\n        }))\n      };\n    }\n\n    const requestBody: any = {\n      contents\n    };\n\n    if (systemInstruction) {\n      requestBody.systemInstruction = {\n        parts: [{ text: systemInstruction }]\n      };\n    }\n\n    const generationConfig: any = {\n      maxOutputTokens: config.maxTokens,\n    };\n\n    if (config.temperature !== undefined) {\n      generationConfig.temperature = config.temperature;\n    }\n\n    if (config.topP !== undefined) {\n      generationConfig.topP = config.topP;\n    }\n\n    requestBody.generationConfig = generationConfig;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class ToolExecutor {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 执行 Agent 嵌套调用工具\n   */\n  private async executeAgent(toolConfig: ToolConfig, args: any): Promise&lt;ToolExecutionResult&gt; {\n    try {\n      const implementation = toolConfig.implementation;\n      if (!implementation || !implementation.agentId) {\n        return {\n          success: false,\n          content: JSON.stringify({ error: 'Agent ID 未配置' })\n        };\n      }\n\n      const agentId = implementation.agentId;\n      const query = args.query || args.input || JSON.stringify(args);\n\n      // 检查调用深度（防止无限递归）\n      const maxDepth = 3;\n      const currentDepth = args._callDepth || 0;\n      if (currentDepth &gt;= maxDepth) {\n        return {\n          success: false,\n          content: JSON.stringify({ \n            error: &#96;Agent嵌套调用深度超过限制: ${maxDepth}&#96;,\n            currentDepth,\n            maxDepth\n          })\n        };\n      }\n\n      // 获取 Agent 配置\n      const agent = await aiRoleModel.getById(agentId);\n      if (!agent || !agent.enabled) {\n        return {\n          success: false,\n          content: JSON.stringify({ error: &#96;Agent 不存在或已禁用: ${agentId}&#96; })\n        };\n      }\n\n      // 只支持 Direct Agent 类型的嵌套调用\n      if (agent.provider !== 'direct-agent') {\n        return {\n          success: false,\n          content: JSON.stringify({ \n            error: &#96;Agent ${agentId} 不是 Direct Agent 类型，不支持嵌套调用&#96;,\n            provider: agent.provider\n          })\n        };\n      }\n\n      // 调用 AgentOrchestrator 执行嵌套 Agent\n      const orchestrator = new AgentOrchestrator();\n      \n      // 从args中提取context，但不包括_callDepth\n      const context: Record&lt;string, any&gt; = { ...args };\n      delete context._callDepth;\n      delete context.query;\n      delete context.input;\n      \n      // 传递调用深度信息\n      const nestedContext = {\n        ...context,\n        _callDepth: currentDepth + 1\n      };\n\n      const result = await orchestrator.executeAgent\n;\n  }\n}",

| Dify平台统一客户端 | &#96;aiSearch()&#96;, &#96;techPackage()&#96;, etc. | DifyGateway |\n| **LangGraphEngine** | &#96;services/workflow/langgraph/LangGraphEngine.ts&#96; | DAG工作流执行引擎 | &#96;execute()&#96; | NodeRegistry, AgentOrchestrator, DifyGateway |\n| **NodeRegistry** | &#96;services/workflow/nodes/NodeRegistry.ts&#96; | 节点类型插件化注册 | &#96;register()&#96;, &#96;execute()&#96; | 9种节点执行器 |\n\n### 2.3 Direct Agent配置结构\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\ninterface DirectAgentConfig {\n  llm: {\n    provider: 'openai' | 'azure-openai' | 'qwen' | 'ernie' | 'custom';\n    apiKey: string;\n    apiBaseUrl?: string;\n    model: string;\n    temperature: number;\n    maxTokens: number;\n    topP?: number;\n    stream?: boolean;\n  };\n  prompt: {\n    systemPrompt: string;\n    variables?: PromptVariable[];\n    templates?: PromptTemplate[];\n  };\n  contextStrategy: {\n    type: 'window' | 'summary' | 'hybrid';\n    maxMessages: number;\n    maxTokens: number;\n    summaryThreshold?: number;\n    includeSystemPrompt: boolean;\n  };\n  tools?: ToolConfig[];\n  agentCalls?: AgentCallConfig[];\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2.4 节点插件化系统（已优化实现）\n\n**支持的9种节点类型**：\n\n| 节点类型 | 执行器类 | 功能 | 状态 |\n|---------|---------|------|------|\n| &#96;input&#96; | &#96;InputNodeExecutor&#96; | 提取工作流输入参数 | ✅ |\n| &#96;agent&#96; | &#96;AgentNodeExecutor&#96; | 调用AI角色（支持Direct/Dify） | ✅ |\n| &#96;output&#96; | &#96;OutputNodeExecutor&#96; | 提取最终输出 | ✅ |\n| &#96;condition&#96; | &#96;ConditionNodeExecutor&#96; | 条件判断（支持gating） | ✅ |\n| &#96;assign&#96; | &#96;AssignNodeExecutor&#96; | 变量赋值 | ✅ |\n| &#96;transform&#96; | &#96;TransformNodeExecutor&#96; | 数据转换 | ✅ |\n| &#96;merge&#96;         "contents": "export class ToolExecutor {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 执行工具调用\n   * @param toolCall 工具调用信息\n   * @param toolConfig 工具配置\n   * @returns 执行结果（JSON 字符串）\n   */\n  async executeTool(toolCall: ToolCall, toolConfig: ToolConfig): Promise&lt;string&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 解析参数\n      const args = JSON.parse(toolCall.function.arguments || '{}');\n\n      // 验证参数\n      this.validateParameters(args, toolConfig.parameters);\n\n      // 根据工具类型执行\n      let result: ToolExecutionResult;\n\n      switch (toolConfig.type) {\n        case 'search':\n          result = await this.executeSearch(args);\n          break;\n\n        case 'calculation':\n          result = this.executeCalculation(args);\n          break;\n\n        case 'time':\n          result = this.getTime(args);\n          break;\n\n        case 'api':\n          result = await this.executeAPI(toolConfig, args);\n          break;\n\n        case 'workflow':\n          result = await this.executeWorkflow(toolConfig, args);\n          break;\n\n        case 'agent':\n          result = await this.executeAgent(toolConfig, args);\n          break;\n\n        default:\n          result = {\n            success: false,\n            content: JSON.stringify({ error: &#96;不支持的工具类型: ${toolConfig.type}&#96; })\n          };\n      }\n\n      if (!result.success) {\n        return JSON.stringify({ error: result.error || '工具执行失败' });\n      }\n\n      return result.content;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(&#96;工具执行失败: ${toolConfig.name}&#96;, error);\n      return JSON.stringify({\n        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '工具执行失败'\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 验证参数\n   */\n  private validateParameters(args: any, parameters: ToolConfig['parameters']): void {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export const PRESET_ROLES: Record&lt;string, Partial&lt;AIRoleConfig&gt;&gt; = {\n\n  'three-fix-analysis': {\n    name: '用户场景挖掘（三定）助手',\n    description: '用于分析用户场景，进行定性、定量、定级分析，挖掘核心用户需求。',\n    provider: 'direct-agent',\n    agentConfig: {\n      llm: {\n        provider: 'openai',\n        model: 'gpt-4o',\n        temperature: 0.7,\n        maxTokens: 2000,\n        apiKey: 'sk-placeholder-please-update', // 用户需自行配置\n      },\n      prompt: {\n        systemPrompt: &#96;你是一位资深的用户场景分析专家，擅长使用\"三定\"（定性、定量、定级）方法论来挖掘用户需求。\n\n你的任务是分析输入的用户场景或需求描述，并输出详细的分析报告。\n\n**分析维度：**\n1. **定性分析 (Qualitative Analysis)**:\n   - 定义场景的核心痛点和用户目标。\n   - 描述用户在当前场景下的行为模式和心理状态。\n   - 识别场景中的关键触点。\n\n2. **定量分析 (Quantitative Analysis)**:\n   - 估算该场景的市场规模或发生频率（基于通用知识或提供的数据）。\n   - 评估解决该问题的潜在价值（如节省的时间、提升的效率）。\n\n3. **定级分析 (Grading/Prioritization)**:\n   - 根据痛点强烈程度和市场价值，对需求进行评级（S/A/B/C）。\n   - S级：核心痛点，高频高价值。\n   - A级：重要需求，高频或高价值。\n   - B级：次要需求，锦上添花。\n   - C级：低价值需求。\n\n请以结构化的Markdown格式输出分析结果。&#96;,\n      },\n      contextStrategy: DEFAULT_CONTEXT_STRATEGY\n    }\n  },\n  'tech-matrix': {\n    name: '技术矩阵助手',\n};",

## 修复内容

### 1. 后端修复（`AgentOrchestrator.ts`）
- 添加对 `config.prompt` 和 `config.prompt.systemPrompt` 的检查
- 添加对 `config.contextStrategy` 的检查
- 配置缺失时抛出明确错误，避免 `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'systemPrompt')`

### 2. 前端修复（`EmbeddedBrainstormPage.tsx`）
- 使用 `useRef` 存储轮询 interval，避免 state 依赖导致的循环
- 使用 `useCallback` 包装相关函数，确保依赖正确
- 优化 `loadSessions`：使用函数式更新 `selectedSession`，移除对 `selectedSession` 的依赖
- 改进错误处理：
  - `startPolling` 中添加错误计数，连续错误超过 3 次时停止轮询
  - `loadMessages` 发生错误时停止轮询
- 优化状态更新：仅在会话数据真正变化时更新 `selectedSession`

这些修复应解决：
1. `systemPrompt` 未定义错误
2. 无限刷新问题

请刷新页面测试。如仍有问题，请告知。

        "contents": "export class BrainstormSessionModel {\n\n\n\n  /**\n   * 创建会话\n   */\n  async create(data: CreateBrainstormSessionDTO): Promise&lt;BrainstormSessionDTO&gt; {\n    const id = data.id || this.generateId();\n    const now = new Date().toISOString();\n    \n    const defaultConfig: BrainstormSessionConfig = {\n      stopConditions: {\n        manualStop: true,\n        maxRounds: 5,\n        consensusDetection: false,\n        consensusConfig: {\n          enabled: false,\n          method: 'hybrid',\n          threshold: 0.7,\n          minAgreementRatio: 0.7,\n          recentRounds: 3,\n        },\n      },\n      discussionMode: 'parallel',\n      summaryConfig: {\n        enabled: true,\n        provider: 'same-as-agents',\n      },\n      reflectionLoop: {\n        enabled: false,\n        maxIterations: 3,\n        qualityThreshold: 0.7,\n        reflectionFrequency: 3,\n      },\n      structuredContext: {\n        enabled: true,\n        summaryFrequency: 3,\n        extractKeyPoints: true,\n        detectDisagreements: true,\n        maxContextTokens: 8000,\n      },\n      debateConfig: {\n        enabled: false,\n        proRoleIds: [],\n        conRoleIds: [],\n        rounds: 3,\n      },\n    };\n\n    const config = { ...defaultConfig, ...data.config };\n    \n    const sql = &#96;\n      INSERT INTO brainstorm_sessions \n      (id, title, topic, description, creator_id, status, config, created_at, updated_at)\n      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'draft', ?, ?, ?)\n    &#96;;\n    \n    await this.db.query(sql, [\n      id,\n      data.title,\n      data.topic,\n      data.description || null,\n      data.creatorId || null,\n      JSON.stringify(config),\n      now,\n      now,\n    ]);\n\n    // 添加参与者\n    if (data.participantRoleIds.length &gt; 0) {\n      const participantModel = new BrainstormParticipantModel(this.db);\n      for (let i = 0; i &lt; data.participantRoleIds.length; i++) {\n        await participantModel.create({\n          sessionId: id,\n          aiRoleId: data.participantRoleIds[i],\n          sortOrder: i,\n        });\n      }\n    }\n\n    return this.getById(id);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据ID获取会话\n   */\n  async getById(id: string): Promise&lt;BrainstormSessionDTO&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      SELECT * FROM brainstorm_sessions WHERE id = ?\n    &#96;;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "const BrainstormPage: React.FC = \n\n\n  const loadSessions = async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      setLoading(true);\n      const data = await brainstormService.listSessions();\n      setSessions(data);\n      \n      // 如果有选中的会话，更新它\n      if (selectedSession) {\n        const updated = data.find(s =&gt; s.id === selectedSession.id);\n        if (updated) {\n          setSelectedSession(updated);\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载会话列表失败:', error);\n      toast.error('加载会话列表失败');\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const loadMessages = async (sessionId: string) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      setLoadingMessages(true);\n      const data = await brainstormService.getMessages(sessionId);\n      setMessages(data);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载消息失败:', error);\n      toast.error('加载消息失败');\n    } finally {\n      setLoadingMessages(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const startPolling = (sessionId: string) =&gt; {\n    // 如果会话是活跃状态，每3秒轮询一次\n    const interval = setInterval(async () =&gt; {\n      try {\n        const status = await brainstormService.getSessionStatus(sessionId);\n        if (status.isActive || status.status === 'active') {\n          await loadMessages(sessionId);\n          // 同时更新会话状态\n          const updated = await brainstormService.getSession(sessionId);\n          setSelectedSession(updated);\n        } else {\n          // 讨论已结束，停止轮询\n          stopPolling();\n          await loadMessages(sessionId);\n          const updated = await brainstormService.getSession(sessionId);\n          setSelectedSession(updated);\n        }\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('轮询失败:', error);\n      }\n    }, 3000);\n\n    setPollingInterval(interval);\n  };\n\n  const stopPolling = () =&gt; {\n    if (pollingInterval) {\n      clearInterval(pollingInterval);\n      setPollingInterval(null);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleCreateSession = async (data: CreateBrainstormSessionDTO) =&gt;\n;\n;",

        "contents": "import {\n  brainstormSessionModel,\n  brainstormParticipantModel,\n  brainstormMessageModel,\n  aiRoleModel,\n} from '../../models';\nimport {\n  BrainstormSessionDTO,\n  CreateBrainstormSessionDTO,\n  UpdateBrainstormSessionDTO,\n  BrainstormParticipantDTO,\n  AddParticipantDTO,\n  BrainstormMessageDTO,\n} from '../../models/Brainstorm';\n\n/**\n * 头脑风暴业务服务\n */\nexport class BrainstormService {\n  /**\n   * 创建会话\n   */\n  async createSession(data: CreateBrainstormSessionDTO): Promise&lt;BrainstormSessionDTO&gt; {\n    // 验证参与者角色是否存在\n    for (const roleId of data.participantRoleIds) {\n      const role = await aiRoleModel.getById(roleId);\n      if (!role) {\n        throw new Error(&#96;AI角色不存在: ${roleId}&#96;);\n      }\n      if (!role.enabled) {\n        throw new Error(&#96;AI角色未启用: ${roleId}&#96;);\n      }\n    }\n\n    const session = await brainstormSessionModel.create(data);\n    \n    // 加载参与者信息\n    const participants = await brainstormParticipantModel.getBySessionId(session.id);\n    session.participants = participants;\n    \n    return session;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取会话列表\n   */\n  async listSessions(options: {\n    creatorId?: string;\n    status?: string;\n    limit?: number;\n    offset?: number;\n  } = {}): Promise&lt;BrainstormSessionDTO[]&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "const EmbeddedBrainstormPage: React.FC&lt;EmbeddedBrainstormPageProps&gt; = \n() =&gt; {\n\n  }, [loadSources, loadSessions]);\n\n  // 当选中会话变化时，加载消息\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    if (selectedSession) {\n      loadMessages(selectedSession.id);\n      startPolling(selectedSession.id);\n    } else {\n      stopPolling();\n    }\n\n    return () =&gt; {\n      stopPolling();\n    };\n  }, [selectedSession?.id, loadMessages, startPolling, stopPolling]);\n\n  const handleCreateSession = async (data: CreateBrainstormSessionDTO) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const session = await brainstormService.createSession(data);\n      setSessions([session, ...sessions]);\n      setSelectedSession(session);\n      setIsSetupModalOpen(false);\n      toast.success('会话创建成功');\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('创建会话失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleStartSession = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!selectedSession) return;\n\n    try {\n      await brainstormService.startSession(selectedSession.id);\n      toast.success('讨论已启动');\n      // 重新加载会话状态\n      const updated = await brainstormService.getSession(selectedSession.id);\n      setSelectedSession(updated);\n      startPolling(selectedSession.id);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('启动讨论失败:', error);\n      toast.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : '启动讨论失败');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleStopSession = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!selectedSession) return;\n\n    try {\n      await brainstormService.stopSession(selectedSession.id);\n      toast.success('讨论已停止');\n      stopPolling();\n      // 重新加载会话状态\n      const updated = await brainstormService.getSession(selectedSession.id);\n      setSelectedSession(updated);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('停止讨论失败:', error);\n      toast.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : '停止讨论失败');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleDeleteSession = async (sessionId: string) =&gt;\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const EmbeddedBrainstormPage: React.FC&lt;EmbeddedBrainstormPageProps&gt; = \n\n\n  const loadSessions = useCallback(async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      setLoading(true);\n      const data = await brainstormService.listSessions();\n      setSessions(data);\n      \n      // 如果有选中的会话，更新它（只有当会话真的改变时才更新）\n      setSelectedSession(prev =&gt; {\n        if (!prev) return prev;\n        const updated = data.find(s =&gt; s.id === prev.id);\n        if (updated &amp;&amp; JSON.stringify(updated) !== JSON.stringify(prev)) {\n          return updated;\n        }\n        return prev;\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载会话列表失败:', error);\n      toast.error('加载会话列表失败');\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  }, []);\n\n  const loadMessages = useCallback(async (sessionId: string) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      setLoadingMessages(true);\n      const data = await brainstormService.getMessages(sessionId);\n      setMessages(data);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载消息失败:', error);\n      toast.error('加载消息失败');\n      // 发生错误时停止轮询，避免无限重试\n      stopPolling();\n    } finally {\n      setLoadingMessages(false);\n    }\n  }, []);\n\n  const stopPolling = useCallback(() =&gt; {\n    if (pollingIntervalRef.current) {\n      clearInterval(pollingIntervalRef.current);\n      pollingIntervalRef.current = null;\n    }\n  }, []);\n\n  const startPolling = useCallback((sessionId: string) =&gt; {\n    // 先停止之前的轮询\n    stopPolling();\n  };\n;",
