        "contents": "-- 头脑风暴群聊功能数据库表结构\n-- 用于存储多Agent协作讨论的会话、参与者和消息\n\n-- 1. 头脑风暴会话表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brainstorm_sessions (\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    title TEXT NOT NULL,\n    topic TEXT NOT NULL,\n    description TEXT,\n    creator_id TEXT,\n    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'active', 'completed', 'stopped')),\n    config TEXT, -- JSON格式存储配置（终止条件等）\n    summary TEXT, -- AI生成的讨论总结\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    completed_at DATETIME\n);\n\n-- 2. 参与者表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brainstorm_participants (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    session_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n    ai_role_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n    display_name TEXT,\n    role_type TEXT, -- 角色类型（专家领域）\n    sort_order INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES brainstorm_sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 3. 讨论消息表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brainstorm_messages (\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    session_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n    participant_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    round_number INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n    content TEXT NOT NULL,\n    reply_to_id TEXT, -- 回复的消息ID（可选）\n    metadata TEXT, -- JSON格式存储元数据（token使用等）\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES brainstorm_sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (participant_id) REFERENCES brainstorm_participants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (reply_to_id) REFERENCES brainstorm_messages(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\n);\n\n-- 创建索引以提高查询性能\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_brainstorm_sessions_status ON brainstorm_sessions(status);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_brainstorm_sessions_created_at ON brainstorm_sessions(created_at DESC);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_brainstorm_sessions_creator_id ON brainstorm_sessions(creator_id);\n\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_brainstorm_participants_session_id ON brainstorm_participants(session_id);",

        "contents": "const BrainstormPage: React.FC = \n\n\n  // 加载来源信息（根据是否有 projectId 选择不同的查询方式）\n  const loadSources = useCallback(async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      setLoadingSources(true);\n      let result;\n      \n      if (projectId) {\n        // 如果有项目ID，使用项目级查询\n        const projectIdNum = parseInt(projectId);\n        if (!isNaN(projectIdNum)) {\n          result = await sourceService.loadSourceInformationByProjectId(projectIdNum);\n        } else {\n          console.warn('[BrainstormPage] 无效的项目ID:', projectId);\n          return;\n        }\n      } else {\n        // 如果没有项目ID，使用页面类型查询\n        result = await sourceService.loadSourceInformationByPageType('tech-strategy');\n      }\n      \n      if (result.success &amp;&amp; result.data) {\n        setSources(result.data);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载来源信息失败:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setLoadingSources(false);\n    }\n  }, [projectId]);\n\n  // 加载项目信息\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const loadProject = async () =&gt; {\n      if (projectId) {\n        const projectIdNum = parseInt(projectId);\n        if (!isNaN(projectIdNum)) {\n          try {\n            const result = await projectService.getProjectById(projectIdNum);\n            if (result.success &amp;&amp; result.data) {\n              setProject(result.data);\n            }\n          } catch (error) {\n            console.error('加载项目信息失败:', error);\n          }\n        }\n      } else {\n        setProject(null);\n      }\n    };\n    loadProject();\n  }, [projectId]);\n\n  // 加载会话列表\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    loadSessions();\n    loadSources();\n  }, [loadSources]);\n\n  // 当选中会话变化时，加载消息\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    if (selectedSession) {\n      loadMessages(selectedSession.id);\n      startPolling(selectedSession.id);\n    } else {\n      stopPolling();\n    }\n\n    return () =&gt; {\n      stopPolling();\n    };\n  }, [selectedSession?.id]);\n\n  const loadSessions = async () =&gt; {\n    try\n;\n;",

        "contents": "-- 迁移脚本：为 tech_points 表添加 TPD2 同步相关字段\n-- 执行日期：2025-12-08\n-- 说明：添加 tpd_id, car_models_info, resources_info 字段，实现单表管理\n\n-- SQLite 版本\n-- 注意：SQLite 不支持直接 ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN 添加多个列，需要逐个添加\n\n-- 1. 添加 tpd_id 字段（用于存储 TPD2 项目的原始 ID，作为同步锚点）\nALTER TABLE tech_points ADD COLUMN tpd_id VARCHAR(100);\n\n-- 2. 添加 car_models_info 字段（JSON 格式存储车型信息）\nALTER TABLE tech_points ADD COLUMN car_models_info TEXT;\n\n-- 3. 添加 resources_info 字段（JSON 格式存储资源信息）\nALTER TABLE tech_points ADD COLUMN resources_info TEXT;\n\n-- 4. 添加 knowledge_info 字段（JSON 格式存储知识点详情，整合现有字段）\nALTER TABLE tech_points ADD COLUMN knowledge_info TEXT;\n\n-- 5. 为 tpd_id 创建索引（用于快速查找和同步）\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tech_points_tpd_id ON tech_points(tpd_id);\n\n-- PostgreSQL 版本（如果需要）\n-- 注意：PostgreSQL 支持一次添加多个列\n/*\nALTER TABLE tech_points \n  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS tpd_id VARCHAR(100),\n  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS car_models_info JSONB,\n  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS resources_info JSONB,\n  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_info JSONB;\n\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tech_points_tpd_id ON tech_points(tpd_id);\n*/",

        "contents": "async function addTechPointIdToKnowledgePoints(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n\n\n    for (const field of requiredFields) {\n      let fieldExists = false;\n      if (dbType === 'sqlite') {\n        const tableInfo = await db.query('PRAGMA table_info(knowledge_points)');\n        const columns = Array.isArray(tableInfo) ? tableInfo : [tableInfo];\n        fieldExists = columns.some((col: any) =&gt; col.name === field.name);\n      } else {\n        const checkResult = await db.query(&#96;\n          SELECT EXISTS (\n            SELECT FROM information_schema.columns \n            WHERE table_schema = 'public' \n            AND table_name = 'knowledge_points' \n            AND column_name = $1\n          )\n        &#96;, [field.name]);\n        fieldExists = checkResult[0]?.exists === true;\n      }\n\n      if (!fieldExists) {\n        try {\n          if (dbType === 'sqlite') {\n            await db.query(&#96;\n              ALTER TABLE knowledge_points \n              ADD COLUMN ${field.name} ${field.type} DEFAULT ${field.default}\n            &#96;);\n          } else {\n            await db.query(&#96;\n              ALTER TABLE knowledge_points \n              ADD COLUMN ${field.name} ${field.type} DEFAULT ${field.default}\n            &#96;);\n          }\n          console.log(&#96;✅ 已添加字段: ${field.name}&#96;);\n        } catch (error: any) {\n          console.warn(&#96;⚠️  添加字段 ${field.name} 失败:&#96;, error.message);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    console.log('\\n✅ 迁移完成！');\n  } catch (error: any) {\n    console.error('❌ 迁移失败:', error.message);\n    throw error;\n  } finally {\n    await db.close();\n    console.log('\\n🔌 数据库连接已关闭');\n  }\n}\n\n// 执行迁移\nif (require.main === module)",

        },
        "contents": "/**\n * 添加AI角色和工作流追踪字段的迁移脚本\n * 创建日期: 2025-11-01\n * 目的: 为统计表添加AI角色ID和工作流执行ID字段，建立关联关系\n */\n\nimport { DatabaseManager } from '../config/database';\nimport * as fs from 'fs';\nimport * as path from 'path';\n\nconst db = new DatabaseManager();\n\n/**\n * 运行迁移脚本\n */\nasync function runMigration() {\n  try {\n    console.log('🚀 开始添加AI角色和工作流追踪字段...');\n    \n    // 确保数据库连接\n    await db.connect();\n    \n    // 检查ai_roles表是否存在\n    const checkAIRolesTable = &#96;\n      SELECT name FROM sqlite_master \n      WHERE type='table' AND name='ai_roles'\n    &#96;;\n    const aiRolesTableExists = await db.query(checkAIRolesTable);\n    \n    if (aiRolesTableExists.length === 0) {\n      console.warn('⚠️  ai_roles 表不存在，将仅添加字段，无法建立外键关联。');\n    }\n\n    // 检查workflow_executions表是否存在\n    const checkWorkflowExecTable = &#96;\n      SELECT name FROM sqlite_master \n      WHERE type='table' AND name='workflow_executions'\n    &#96;;\n    const workflowExecTableExists = await db.query(checkWorkflowExecTable);\n    \n    if (workflowExecTableExists.length === 0) {\n      console.warn('⚠️  workflow_executions 表不存在，将仅添加字段，无法建立外键关联。');\n    }\n\n    // 1. 为workflow_node_usage表添加字段\n    console.log('📝 步骤1: 为workflow_node_usage表添加字段...');\n    \n    // 检查ai_role_id字段是否已存在\n    const checkAIRoleIdColumn = &#96;\n      SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM pragma_table_info('workflow_node_usage') \n      WHERE name='ai_role_id'\n    &#96;;\n    const aiRoleIdExists = await db.query(checkAIRoleIdColumn);\n    \n    if (aiRoleIdExists[0]?.count === 0) {\n      await db.query('ALTER TABLE workflow_node_usage ADD COLUMN ai_role_id TEXT');\n      console.log('  ✅ 添加ai_role_id字段');\n    } else {\n      console.log('  ℹ️  ai_role_id字段已存在');\n    }\n\n    // 检查workflow_execution_id字段是否已存在\n}",

        "contents": "-- 添加AI角色和工作流追踪字段的迁移脚本\n-- 创建日期: 2025-11-01\n-- 目的: 为统计表添加AI角色ID和工作流执行ID字段，建立关联关系\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 1. 为工作流节点使用统计表添加字段\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 添加ai_role_id字段（关联AI角色配置）\nALTER TABLE workflow_node_usage ADD COLUMN ai_role_id TEXT;\n\n-- 添加workflow_execution_id字段（关联工作流执行实例）\nALTER TABLE workflow_node_usage ADD COLUMN workflow_execution_id TEXT;\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 2. 为AI问答评价表添加字段\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 添加ai_role_id字段（关联AI角色配置）\nALTER TABLE ai_qa_feedback ADD COLUMN ai_role_id TEXT;\n\n-- 添加workflow_execution_id字段（关联工作流执行实例）\nALTER TABLE ai_qa_feedback ADD COLUMN workflow_execution_id TEXT;\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 3. 为节点内容处理统计表添加字段\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 添加ai_role_id字段（关联AI角色配置）\nALTER TABLE node_content_processing ADD COLUMN ai_role_id TEXT;\n\n-- 添加workflow_execution_id字段（关联工作流执行实例）\nALTER TABLE node_content_processing ADD COLUMN workflow_execution_id TEXT;\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 4. 创建索引以提高查询性能\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 工作流节点使用统计索引\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_workflow_node_usage_ai_role_id ON workflow_node_usage(ai_role_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_workflow_node_usage_workflow_execution_id ON workflow_node_usage(workflow_execution_id);\n\n-- AI问答评价索引\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ai_qa_feedback_ai_role_id ON ai_qa_feedback(ai_role_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ai_qa_feedback_workflow_execution_id ON ai_qa_feedback(workflow_execution_id);\n\n-- 节点内容处理索引\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_node_content_processing_ai_role_id ON node_content_processing(ai_role_id);",

        "contents": "export class PublicPageConfigModel {\nasync initializeTable(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\nconst indexes = [\n',\n    ];\n    \n    for (const indexSQL of indexes) {\n      try {\n        await this.db.query(indexSQL);\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        // 忽略索引已存在的错误\n        if (!error.message?.includes('already exists') &amp;&amp; !error.message?.includes('duplicate')) {\n          console.warn('创建索引时出现警告:', error.message);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    \n    // 创建触发器\n    const triggerSQL = &#96;\n      CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS update_public_page_configs_updated_at\n      AFTER UPDATE ON public_page_configs\n      BEGIN\n        UPDATE public_page_configs SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = NEW.id;\n      END;\n    &#96;;\n    \n    try {\n      await this.db.query(triggerSQL);\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      // 忽略触发器已存在的错误\n      if (!error.message?.includes('already exists') &amp;&amp; !error.message?.includes('duplicate')) {\n        console.warn('创建触发器时出现警告:', error.message);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 迁移：添加模板相关字段（如果不存在）\n    try {\n      // 检查字段是否存在\n      const tableInfo = await this.db.query('PRAGMA table_info(public_page_configs)');\n      const columns = Array.isArray(tableInfo) ? tableInfo : tableInfo.rows || [tableInfo];\n      const columnNames = columns.map((col: any) =&gt; col.name);\n      \n      if (!columnNames.includes('template_type')) {\n        await this.db.query('ALTER TABLE public_page_configs ADD COLUMN template_type TEXT');\n      }\n      if (!columnNames.includes('custom_html')) {\n        await this.db.query('ALTER TABLE public_page_configs ADD COLUMN custom_html TEXT');\n      }\n      if (!columnNames.includes('address')) {\n        await this.db.query('ALTER TABLE public_page_configs ADD COLUMN address TEXT');\n      }\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      // 忽略列已存在的错误\n      if (!error.message?.includes('duplicate column')) {\n        console.warn('添加字段时出现警告:', error.message);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 创建公开页面配置\n   */\n  async create(data: CreatePublicPageConfigDTO): Promise&lt;PublicPageConfigDTO&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "async function createKnowledgePointsTable(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n\n\n      for (const field of requiredFields) {\n        let fieldExists = false;\n        if (dbType === 'sqlite') {\n          const tableInfo = await db.query('PRAGMA table_info(knowledge_points)');\n          const columns = Array.isArray(tableInfo) ? tableInfo : [tableInfo];\n          fieldExists = columns.some((col: any) =&gt; col.name === field.name);\n        } else {\n          const checkResult = await db.query(&#96;\n            SELECT EXISTS (\n              SELECT FROM information_schema.columns \n              WHERE table_schema = 'public' \n              AND table_name = 'knowledge_points' \n              AND column_name = $1\n            )\n          &#96;, [field.name]);\n          fieldExists = checkResult[0]?.exists === true;\n        }\n\n        if (!fieldExists) {\n          try {\n            await db.query(&#96;\n              ALTER TABLE knowledge_points \n              ADD COLUMN ${field.name} ${field.type} DEFAULT ${field.default}\n            &#96;);\n            console.log(&#96;✅ 已添加字段: ${field.name}&#96;);\n          } catch (error: any) {\n            console.warn(&#96;⚠️  添加字段 ${field.name} 失败:&#96;, error.message);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n\n      // 添加索引\n      try {\n        await db.query(&#96;\n          CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_knowledge_points_tech_point_id \n          ON knowledge_points(tech_point_id)\n        &#96;);\n        console.log('✅ 已添加索引');\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        // 索引可能已存在，忽略错误\n      }\n\n      return;\n    }\n\n    console.log('📝 创建 knowledge_points 表...');\n\n    // 创建表（包含所有必要字段）\n    const createTableSql = &#96;\n      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_points (\n        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n        tech_point_id INTEGER,\n        title TEXT NOT NULL,\n        content TEXT NOT NULL,\n        knowledge_type TEXT DEFAULT 'concept',\n        difficulty_level TEXT DEFAULT 'medium',\n        tags TEXT,\n        prerequisites TEXT,\n        learning_objectives TEXT,\n        examples TEXT,\n        \"references\" TEXT,\n        source_query TEXT,\n        source_url TEXT,\n        source_type TEXT DEFAULT 'import' CHECK (source_type IN ('ai_search', 'manual', 'import')),\n        metadata TEXT,\n        relevance_score REAL,\n        status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n        dify_task_id TEXT,\n        ai_search_session_id TEXT,\n        created_by TEXT,\n        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n        updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n        FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n      )\n    &#96;;\n}",

        "contents": "export class SourceInformationService {\nasync initializeTable(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\nconst statements = [\n&#96;,\n        &#96;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_project_source_informations_project_id ON project_source_informations(project_id)&#96;,\n        &#96;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_project_source_informations_source_information_id ON project_source_informations(source_information_id)&#96;\n      ];\n      \n      for (const sql of statements) {\n        try {\n          await db.query(sql);\n        } catch (error: any) {\n          // 忽略表或索引已存在的错误\n          if (error?.message?.includes('already exists') || \n              error?.message?.includes('duplicate') ||\n              error?.code === 'SQLITE_CONSTRAINT') {\n            console.warn('表或索引可能已存在，继续执行:', error.message);\n            continue;\n          }\n          throw error;\n        }\n      }\n      \n      // 检查并添加 project_id 字段（如果表已存在但缺少该字段）\n      try {\n        const tableInfo = await db.query(&#96;PRAGMA table_info(source_information)&#96;);\n        const columns = Array.isArray(tableInfo) ? tableInfo : [tableInfo];\n        const hasProjectId = columns.some((col: any) =&gt; col.name === 'project_id');\n        \n        if (!hasProjectId) {\n          console.log('检测到 source_information 表缺少 project_id 字段，正在添加...');\n          await db.query(&#96;ALTER TABLE source_information ADD COLUMN project_id INTEGER&#96;);\n          await db.query(&#96;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_project_id ON source_information(project_id)&#96;);\n          console.log('成功添加 project_id 字段');\n        }\n      } catch (migrationError: any) {\n        // 如果字段已存在或其他错误，记录但不中断\n        if (!migrationError?.message?.includes('duplicate column')) {\n          console.warn('迁移 project_id 字段时出现警告:', migrationError?.message);\n        }\n      }\n      \n      console.log('来源信息表初始化成功');\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('初始化来源信息表失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 创建来源信息\n   */\n  async createSourceInformation(data: CreateSourceInformationDTO): Promise&lt;SourceInformation&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "-- 项目数据管理重构迁移脚本\n-- 创建日期: 2025-12-05\n-- 说明: 重构项目数据管理架构，以\"项目\"为核心关联所有相关数据\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 1. 确保 projects 表存在（如果不存在则创建）\n-- ==============================================\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS projects (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    description TEXT,\n    cover_image TEXT,\n    icon TEXT,\n    type TEXT DEFAULT 'normal' CHECK (type IN ('normal', 'featured')),\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n    created_by TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    last_opened_at DATETIME\n);\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 2. 项目关联基础信息表（多对多关系）\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 项目与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_tech_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(project_id, tech_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 项目与公开知识点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_knowledge_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    knowledge_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (knowledge_point_id) REFERENCES knowledge_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(project_id, knowledge_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 项目与文件关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_files (\n    ",

        "contents": "-- 更新workflow_executions表结构以支持统一表\n-- 版本: 2.0.0\n-- 创建日期: 2025-01-XX\n-- 说明: 将workflow_executions表更新为统一结构，支持Agent工作流和Dify工作流\n\n-- 由于SQLite的限制，我们需要重新创建表\n-- 步骤：\n-- 1. 创建临时表保存旧数据\n-- 2. 删除旧表\n-- 3. 创建新表\n-- 4. 迁移数据\n-- 5. 删除临时表\n\n-- 创建临时表保存旧数据\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workflow_executions_old AS SELECT * FROM workflow_executions;\n\n-- 删除旧表和相关索引\nDROP TABLE IF EXISTS workflow_executions;\n\n-- 创建新表（统一结构）\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workflow_executions (\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    execution_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (execution_type IN ('agent_workflow', 'dify_workflow')),\n    \n    -- Agent工作流执行字段\n    workflow_id TEXT,                  -- 关联agent_workflows.id\n    workflow_name TEXT,\n    shared_context TEXT DEFAULT '{}',  -- JSON字符串，共享上下文\n    node_results TEXT DEFAULT '[]',    -- JSON字符串，节点执行结果列表\n    \n    -- Dify工作流执行字段\n    workflow_run_id TEXT UNIQUE,       -- Dify工作流运行ID\n    task_id TEXT,                      -- Dify任务ID\n    message_id TEXT,                    -- 关联chat_messages.message_id\n    app_type TEXT,                      -- 应用类型\n    \n    -- 通用执行字段\n    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',\n    error_message TEXT,                -- 错误信息\n    inputs TEXT,                        -- JSON格式存储输入\n    outputs TEXT,                       -- JSON格式存储输出\n    \n    -- 执行统计\n    elapsed_time REAL DEFAULT 0,        -- 执行时间（秒）\n    total_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    total_steps INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    duration INTEGER,                   -- 持续时间（毫秒，用于Agent工作流）\n    \n    -- 时间戳\n    start_time TIMESTAMP,              -- 开始时间\n    end_time TIMESTAMP,                -- 结束时间\n    started_at DATETIME,                -- 开始时间（Dify工作流）",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "-- 来源信息项目关联迁移脚本\n-- 创建日期: 2025-01-XX\n-- 说明: 将来源信息从 page_type 维度迁移到项目维度\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 1. 添加 project_id 字段到 source_information 表\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 检查并添加 project_id 字段（SQLite 不支持 IF NOT EXISTS，需要先检查）\n-- 如果字段已存在，此操作会失败，需要在应用层处理\n\n-- 添加 project_id 字段\nALTER TABLE source_information ADD COLUMN project_id INTEGER;\n\n-- 创建索引\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_project_id ON source_information(project_id);\n\n-- 添加外键约束（SQLite 3.37.0+ 支持，旧版本可能需要重建表）\n-- 注意：SQLite 的 ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN 不支持直接添加外键\n-- 如果需要外键约束，需要重建表，这里先添加字段，外键约束在应用层处理\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 2. 从 page_type 中提取项目 ID 并更新 project_id\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 更新 project_id：从 page_type 中提取项目ID\n-- 格式: tech-package-project-123, tech-strategy-project-456 等\nUPDATE source_information\nSET project_id = CAST(\n  SUBSTR(\n    page_type,\n    INSTR(page_type, 'project-') + 8\n  ) AS INTEGER\n)\nWHERE page_type LIKE '%-project-%'\n  AND project_id IS NULL;\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 3. 清理 page_type 字段，保留标准格式\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 将 tech-package-project-123 格式转换为 tech-package\nUPDATE source_information\nSET page_type = SUBSTR(page_type, 1, INSTR(page_type, '-project-') - 1)\nWHERE page_type LIKE '%-project-%'\n  AND INSTR(page_type, '-project-') &gt; 0;\n\n-- 将 tech-strategy-project-123 格式转换为 tech-strategy\n-- 注意：上面的 UPDATE 已经处理了所有 -project- 的情况\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 4. 在 project_source_informations 表中建立关联\n-- ==============================================",

        "contents": "-- 为 conversations 表添加 project_id 字段\n-- 用于关联对话与项目\n-- 创建日期: 2025-01-XX\n\n-- 添加 project_id 字段（如果不存在）\n-- SQLite 不支持直接检查列是否存在，需要先尝试添加\n-- 如果列已存在，会报错但可以忽略\n\n-- 方法1: 使用 ALTER TABLE（SQLite 3.2.0+）\nALTER TABLE conversations ADD COLUMN project_id INTEGER;\n\n-- 创建索引以提高查询性能\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_conversations_project_id ON conversations(project_id);\n\n-- 可选：添加外键约束（如果数据库支持）\n-- SQLite 3.37.0+ 支持 ALTER TABLE ADD CONSTRAINT\n-- 注意：SQLite 的外键约束需要先启用 PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;\n-- FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE SET NULL",

        "contents": ");\n\n-- 实时统计汇总表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workflow_stats_summary (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    stat_date DATE NOT NULL, -- 统计日期\n    node_id TEXT NOT NULL, -- 节点ID\n    \n    -- 使用统计\n    total_usage_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    unique_users INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    avg_response_time REAL DEFAULT 0,\n    success_rate REAL DEFAULT 0,\n    \n    -- 内容统计\n    total_characters INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    avg_characters INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    avg_content_quality REAL DEFAULT 0,\n    \n    -- 用户交互统计\n    total_likes INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    total_dislikes INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    total_regenerations INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    total_adoptions INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    total_edits INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    \n    -- 采纳率统计\n    direct_adoption_rate REAL DEFAULT 0,\n    edit_adoption_rate REAL DEFAULT 0,\n    abandonment_rate REAL DEFAULT 0,\n    \n    -- 工作流统计\n    workflow_completion_rate REAL DEFAULT 0,\n    avg_session_duration REAL DEFAULT 0,\n    common_exit_points TEXT, -- JSON格式\n    \n    -- 时间戳\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    \n    UNIQUE(stat_date, node_id)\n);\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 系统表\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 数据库迁移记录表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS database_migrations (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    migration_name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    version TEXT NOT NULL,\n    executed_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    execution_time_ms INTEGER,\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'success' CHECK (status IN ('success', 'failed', 'rolled_back')),\n    error_message TEXT\n);",

        "contents": "-- Todify3 统一数据库架构 v2.0\n-- 创建日期: 2025-01-XX\n-- 说明: 整合所有表定义，统一命名规范，解决表结构冲突\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 第一层：基础数据层\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 品牌表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brands (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    name_en TEXT,\n    logo_url TEXT,\n    country TEXT,\n    founded_year INTEGER,\n    description TEXT,\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'inactive')),\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 车型表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS car_models (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    brand_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    name_en TEXT,\n    category TEXT CHECK (category IN ('sedan', 'suv', 'hatchback', 'coupe', 'convertible', 'wagon', 'pickup', 'van', 'mpv')),\n    launch_year INTEGER,\n    end_year INTEGER,\n    description TEXT,\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'discontinued', 'planned')),\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (brand_id) REFERENCES brands(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 车系表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS car_series (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    model_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\n    name_en VARCHAR(255),\n    description TEXT,\n    launch_year INTEGER,\n    end_year INTEGER,\n    market_segment VARCHAR(100),\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\n    metadata TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(model_id, name)\n);\n\n-- 技术分类表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_categories (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,",

        "contents": "export class AgentWorkflowModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 初始化数据库表\n   */\n  async initializeTable(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n    \n    // 直接执行CREATE TABLE语句（避免文件系统依赖）\n    const createTableSQL = &#96;\n      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_workflows (\n        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n        name TEXT NOT NULL,\n        description TEXT,\n        version TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '1.0.0',\n        nodes TEXT NOT NULL,\n        edges TEXT NOT NULL,\n        metadata TEXT,\n        published INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n        created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n        updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n      );\n    &#96;;\n    \n    try {\n      await this.db.query(createTableSQL);\n      \n      // 尝试添加 published 字段（如果表已存在且字段不存在）\n      try {\n        await this.db.query('ALTER TABLE agent_workflows ADD COLUMN published INTEGER DEFAULT 0');\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        // 忽略字段已存在的错误\n        if (!error.message?.includes('duplicate column') &amp;&amp; !error.message?.includes('already exists')) {\n          console.warn('添加 published 字段时出现警告:', error.message);\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      // 忽略\"表已存在\"等错误\n      if (!error.message?.includes('already exists') &amp;&amp; !error.message?.includes('duplicate')) {\n        console.warn('创建agent_workflows表时出现警告:', error.message);\n      }\n    }\n    \n    // 创建工作流执行表（统一结构，支持Agent工作流和Dify工作流）\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "-- Todify3 统一数据库架构 v3.0\n-- 创建日期: 2025-01-XX\n-- 说明: 优化架构，整合所有表定义，增强约束和性能，支持SQLite和PostgreSQL\n-- 优化点:\n-- 1. 统一字段类型定义，增强数据完整性约束\n-- 2. 添加缺失的表（projects, source_information, public_knowledge等）\n-- 3. 优化时间戳字段处理\n-- 4. 增强CHECK约束\n-- 5. 改进外键约束定义\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 第一层：基础数据层\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 品牌表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brands (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    name_en TEXT,\n    logo_url TEXT,\n    country TEXT,\n    founded_year INTEGER,\n    description TEXT,\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'inactive')),\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 车型表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS car_models (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    brand_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    name_en TEXT,\n    category TEXT CHECK (category IN ('sedan', 'suv', 'hatchback', 'coupe', 'convertible', 'wagon', 'pickup', 'van', 'mpv')),\n    launch_year INTEGER,\n    end_year INTEGER,\n    description TEXT,\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'discontinued', 'planned')),\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (brand_id) REFERENCES brands(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 车系表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS car_series (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    model_id INTEGER NOT NULL,",

        "contents": "/**\n * AI问答服务\n */\nexport class AiSearchService {\n  /**\n   * 初始化数据库表\n   */\n  async initializeTables(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 创建AI问答对话表\n      await db.query(&#96;\n        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ai_search_conversations (\n          id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n          title TEXT NOT NULL,\n          sources TEXT NOT NULL,\n          page_type TEXT,\n          created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n          updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n        )\n      &#96;);\n      \n      // 如果表已存在但没有 page_type 字段，添加该字段\n      try {\n        await db.query(&#96;ALTER TABLE ai_search_conversations ADD COLUMN page_type TEXT&#96;);\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        // 如果字段已存在，忽略错误\n        if (!error?.message?.includes('duplicate column') &amp;&amp; !error?.message?.includes('already exists')) {\n          logger.warn('添加 page_type 字段失败（可能已存在）', { error });\n        }\n      }\n\n      // 如果表已存在但没有 dify_conversation_id 字段，添加该字段\n      try {\n        await db.query(&#96;ALTER TABLE ai_search_conversations ADD COLUMN dify_conversation_id TEXT&#96;);\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        // 如果字段已存在，忽略错误\n        if (!error?.message?.includes('duplicate column') &amp;&amp; !error?.message?.includes('already exists')) {\n          logger.warn('添加 dify_conversation_id 字段失败（可能已存在）', { error });\n        }\n      }\n\n      // 创建AI问答消息表\n      await db.query(&#96;\n        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ai_search_messages (\n          id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n          conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n          role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('user', 'assistant')),\n          content TEXT NOT NULL,\n          sources TEXT,\n          outputs TEXT,\n          created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n          FOREIGN KEY (conversation_id) REFERENCES ai_search_conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n        )\n      &#96;);\n\n      // 创建输出内容表\n      await\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "async function createKnowledgePointsTable(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n\n\n    if (tableExists) {\n      console.log('✅ knowledge_points 表已存在');\n      \n      // 检查是否有 tech_point_id 字段\n      let hasTechPointId = false;\n      if (dbType === 'sqlite') {\n        const tableInfo = await db.query('PRAGMA table_info(knowledge_points)');\n        const columns = Array.isArray(tableInfo) ? tableInfo : [tableInfo];\n        hasTechPointId = columns.some((col: any) =&gt; col.name === 'tech_point_id');\n      } else {\n        const checkResult = await db.query(&#96;\n          SELECT EXISTS (\n            SELECT FROM information_schema.columns \n            WHERE table_schema = 'public' \n            AND table_name = 'knowledge_points' \n            AND column_name = 'tech_point_id'\n          )\n        &#96;);\n        hasTechPointId = checkResult[0]?.exists === true;\n      }\n\n      if (!hasTechPointId) {\n        console.log('📝 添加 tech_point_id 字段...');\n        await db.query(&#96;\n          ALTER TABLE knowledge_points \n          ADD COLUMN tech_point_id INTEGER\n        &#96;);\n        console.log('✅ 已添加 tech_point_id 字段');\n      }\n\n      // 检查其他必要字段\n      const requiredFields = [\n        { name: 'knowledge_type', type: 'TEXT', default: \"'concept'\" },\n        { name: 'difficulty_level', type: 'TEXT', default: \"'medium'\" },\n        { name: 'prerequisites', type: 'TEXT', default: 'NULL' },\n        { name: 'learning_objectives', type: 'TEXT', default: 'NULL' },\n        { name: 'examples', type: 'TEXT', default: 'NULL' },\n        { name: 'references', type: 'TEXT', default: 'NULL' },\n      ];\n\n      for (const field of requiredFields)\n}",

已完成：为头脑风暴会话添加项目ID关联。修改如下：

## 修改总结

### 1. 数据库层面
- 在 `brainstorm_sessions` 表中添加 `project_id` 字段
- 添加迁移逻辑，自动为现有表添加该字段
- 创建 `project_id` 索引以提高查询性能
- 更新 SQL 文件，新安装的数据库也会包含该字段

### 2. 后端层面
- 更新 `BrainstormSessionDTO` 和 `CreateBrainstormSessionDTO` 类型，添加 `projectId` 字段
- 更新 `BrainstormSessionModel`：
  - `create` 方法支持保存 `projectId`
  - `list` 方法支持按 `projectId` 过滤
  - `toDTO` 方法包含 `projectId`
- 更新 `BrainstormService` 和路由，支持 `projectId` 参数

### 3. 前端层面
- 更新 `BrainstormSession` 和 `CreateBrainstormSessionDTO` 类型定义
- 更新 `brainstormService.listSessions`，支持 `projectId` 参数
- 更新 `EmbeddedBrainstormPage`：
  - 加载会话列表时按 `projectId` 过滤
  - 创建会话时自动传递 `projectId`
- 更新 `BrainstormSetupModal`，创建会话时包含 `projectId`

现在不同项目的会话已相互独立。每个项目只能看到和创建属于该项目的会话。数据库迁移会在服务启动时自动执行，为现有表添加 `project_id` 字段。
